  109: node_enrollment_remote_custodian(Config) ->
  110:     Source = ?config(asker, Config), Custodian = ?config(target, Config),
  111:     SourceKey = ?config(asker_pub, Config), HostKey = ?config(target_pub, Config),
  112:     SourceAddr = {"127.0.0.1", ?ASKER_PORT}, HostAddr = ?config(target_addr, Config),
  113:     NodeNs = <<"quod:node">>,
  114:     NodeSource = filename:join(code:priv_dir(quod), "ontologies/quod_node.pl"),
  115:     NodeDir = filename:join(?config(priv_dir, Config), "enrollment-class"),
  116:     {ok, _} = peer:call(Source, quod_ns_sup, start_namespace,
  117:         [NodeNs, #{node_id => SourceKey, mode => create, data_dir => NodeDir,
  118:                    seed_peers => [], genesis_file => NodeSource,
  119:                    external_predicate_modules => [quod_ontology_predicates]}]),
  120:     ok = peer:call(Source, ?MODULE, enrollment_wait_ready, [NodeNs, {isa, node, agent}], 15000),
  121:     NodeAnchor = peer:call(Source, quod_simplex, genesis_hash, [NodeNs]),
  122:     start_brahms(Source, NodeNs, SourceAddr, []),
  123:     {ok, Template} = file:read_file(filename:join(code:priv_dir(quod),
  124:                                                  "ontologies/node_execution.pl")),
  125:     HostNs = <<"node:remote-custodian">>,
  126:     Options = quod_ct:node_identity_options(HostNs, me, HostKey),
  127:     {ok, [#{'A' := HostAnchor}], _} = peer:call(Custodian, quod_prolog, execute,
  128:         [?ROOT_NS, {create_ontology, HostNs, Options, {'A'}}], 30000),
  129:     ok = peer:call(Custodian, ?MODULE, enrollment_wait_ready,
  130:         [HostNs, {instance_of, node, me}], 15000),
  131:     Host = {agent_instance_ref, HostNs, HostAnchor, me},
  132:     {ok, _, _} = peer:call(Custodian, quod_prolog, execute,
  133:         [HostNs, {assertz, {ontology_hosting_policy, NodeNs, NodeAnchor}}]),
  134:     {ok, _, _} = peer:call(Source, quod_prolog, execute, [NodeNs, {transaction, {',',
  135:         {assertz, {node_identity_template, Template}},
  136:         {assertz, {node_identity_allocation, HostKey, Host, Host}}}}]),
  137:     {ok, _, _} = peer:call(Custodian, quod_prolog, execute,
  138:         [?ROOT_NS, {assertz, {ontology_creation_policy, NodeNs, NodeAnchor}}]),
  139:     ok = enrollment_route(Source, HostKey, HostAddr,
  140:         [{?ROOT_NS, ?config(network_id, Config), validator}, {HostNs, HostAnchor, validator}]),
  141:     ok = enrollment_route(Custodian, SourceKey, SourceAddr, [{NodeNs, NodeAnchor, validator}]),
  142:     {Public, _} = Pair = quod_identity:generate(),
  143:     {ok, Instance} = quod_client_goal_parser:format({enrolling, Public}),
  144:     {ok, Bytes} = quod_client_goal:encode(#{network_identity => ?config(network_id, Config),
  145:         signing_public_key => Public, operation_id => crypto:strong_rand_bytes(32),
  146:         agent_namespace => NodeNs, agent_genesis_anchor => NodeAnchor,
  147:         agent_instance_text => Instance, mode => execute, parser_version => 3,
  148:         not_after_ms => quod_time:now_ms() + 30000, goal_text => <<"enroll_node(Ref).">>}),
  149:     Sig = quod_identity:sign(Bytes, quod_identity:key_term(Pair)),
  150:     Result = peer:call(Source, quod_client_goal_ingress, submit, [Bytes, Sig], 60000),
  151:     case Result of
  152:         {ok, _, {normalized, {failed, Reasons}}} ->
  153:             ct:fail({enrollment_failed, quod_wire_term:decode_failure_reasons(Reasons)});
  154:         _ -> ?assertMatch({ok, _, {normalized, {committed, _, _}}}, Result)
  155:     end,
  156:     {ok, [#{'Ref' := {agent_instance_ref, Ns, Anchor, me} = Ref}], _} =
  157:         peer:call(Source, quod_prolog, prove_ro,
  158:             [NodeNs, {node_identity_allocation, Public, {'Ref'}, Host}]),
  159:     ?assertMatch({ok, [_], _}, peer:call(Custodian, quod_prolog, prove_ro,
  160:         [HostNs, {hosts_ontology, Host, Ns, Anchor, discoverable}])),
  161:     ok = peer:call(Custodian, ?MODULE, enrollment_wait_ready,
  162:         [Ns, {agent_key, me, Public, active}], 15000),
  163:     ?assertEqual({error, not_hosted},
  164:         peer:call(Source, quod_ontology, genesis_anchor, [Ns])),
  165:     ?assertMatch({ok, [_], _}, peer:call(Source, quod_prolog, prove_ro,
  166:         [NodeNs, {node_identity_allocation, Public, Ref, Host}])),
  167:     %% No publication or follow has primed this newly created identity yet.
  168:     Cost = peer:call(Custodian, ?MODULE, enrollment_local_evidence_cost,
  169:                   [{Ns, Anchor}, [{HostKey, [HostAddr]}]], 20000),
  170:     ct:pal("Unchanged current reads: ~p", [Cost]),
  171:     automatic_joining_node(Config, NodeAnchor, Host).
  172: 
  173: automatic_joining_node(Config, NodeAnchor,
  174:                       {agent_instance_ref, HostNs, HostAnchor, me} = Host) ->
  175:     Custodian = ?config(target, Config), Applicant = ?config(third, Config),
  176:     HostAddr = ?config(target_addr, Config), NodeNs = <<"quod:node">>,
  177:     HostDir = filename:join(?config(priv_dir, Config), "custodian-identity"),
  178:     NodeDir = filename:join(?config(priv_dir, Config), "applicant-identity"),
  179:     ok = peer:call(Custodian, application, set_env, [quod, identity_dir, HostDir]),
  180:     {ok, HostBlob} = quod_node_actor:reference(HostNs, HostAnchor, <<"me.">>, 3),
  181:     {ok, _} = peer:call(Custodian, quod_node_actor, verify, [HostBlob, ?config(target_pub, Config)]),
  182:     ok = peer:call(Custodian, quod_identity, store_node_actor_pointer, [HostDir, HostBlob]),
  183:     {ok, #{start := {quod_ns, start_link, [HostNs, HostCfg]}}} =
  184:         peer:call(Custodian, supervisor, get_childspec,
  185:             [quod_reg:via({quod_ns_sup, node}), {quod_ns, HostNs}]),
  186:     HostDataDir = peer:call(Custodian, quod_ledger_store, ledger_dir, [HostCfg]),
  187:     ok = peer:call(Custodian, application, set_env,
  188:         [quod, content_data_dir, HostDataDir]),
  189:     ok = peer:call(Applicant, application, set_env, [quod, content_data_dir, NodeDir]),
  190:     lists:foreach(fun({Peer, Dir, Contacts}) ->
  191:         {ok, #{start := {quod_ns, start_link, [?ROOT_NS, RootCfg]}}} =
  192:             peer:call(Peer, supervisor, get_childspec,
  193:                 [quod_reg:via({quod_ns_sup, node}), {quod_ns, ?ROOT_NS}]),
  194:         ok = peer:call(Peer, application, set_env,
  195:             [quod, namespace_static_content, #{?ROOT_NS => RootCfg}]),
  196:         ok = peer:call(Peer, supervisor, terminate_child,
  197:             [quod_reg:via({sup, node}), quod_namespace_manager]),
  198:         {ok, _} = peer:call(Peer, supervisor, restart_child,
  199:             [quod_reg:via({sup, node}), quod_namespace_manager]),
  200:         ok = peer:call(Peer, application, set_env, [quod, directory,
  201:             #{identity_dir => Dir, root_contacts => Contacts}]),
  202:         ok = peer:call(Peer, supervisor, terminate_child, [quod_reg:via({sup, node}), quod_directory_control]),
  203:         {ok, _} = peer:call(Peer, supervisor, restart_child, [quod_reg:via({sup, node}), quod_directory_control]),
  204:         ok = peer:call(Peer, quod_directory_control, start_tracking, [])
  205:     end, [{Custodian, HostDir, []}, {Applicant, NodeDir, [HostAddr]}]),
  206:     ok = enrollment_route(Applicant, ?config(asker_pub, Config), {"127.0.0.1", ?ASKER_PORT},
  207:          [{NodeNs, NodeAnchor, validator}]),
  208:     {ok, _, _} = peer:call(Custodian, quod_prolog, execute,
  209:         [?ROOT_NS, {assertz, {system_ontology, NodeNs, NodeAnchor}}]),
  210:     ok = peer:call(Applicant, application, set_env, [quod, identity_dir, NodeDir]),
  211:     ok = peer:call(Applicant, ?MODULE, enrollment_wait_complete, [], 60000),
  212:     {ok, Blob} = peer:call(Applicant, quod_identity, load_node_actor_pointer, [NodeDir]),
  213:     {ok, #{identity := {Ns, Anchor}, reference := Ref}} = quod_agent_ref:decode(Blob),
  214:     ?assertMatch(#{role := observer}, peer:call(Applicant, quod_simplex, status, [Ns])),
  215:     ?assertMatch(#{role := observer}, peer:call(Applicant, quod_simplex, status, [?ROOT_NS])),
  216:     ?assertMatch({ok, [_], _}, peer:call(Custodian, quod_prolog, prove_ro,
  217:         [HostNs, {hosts_ontology, Host, Ns, Anchor, discoverable}])),
  218:     ?assertMatch({ok, [_], _}, peer:call(Applicant, quod_prolog, prove_ro,
  219:         [Ns, {hosts_ontology, Ref, Ns, Anchor, discoverable}])),
  220:     {ok, Bytes, Sig} = peer:call(Applicant, quod_node_actor, signed_goal,
  221:         [read, true, crypto:strong_rand_bytes(32), quod_time:now_ms() + 30000]),
  222:     ?assertMatch({ok, _, {normalized, {read, _, {answers, _, [_]}}}},
  223:         peer:call(Applicant, quod_client_goal_ingress, submit, [Bytes, Sig], 60000)),
  224:     %% The custodian must validate an observer's publication even though its
  225:     %% own local member is the identity's sole current-tip answerer.
  226:     ApplicantAuthor = {node_actor, Blob},
  227:     {ok, First} = peer:call(Custodian, ?MODULE, enrollment_wait_generation,
  228:                             [ApplicantAuthor, Ref, none], 20000),
  229:     %% No new resync request: renew on the existing authenticated stream and
  230:     %% observe the received generation, not a send trace.
  231:     {ok, _} = peer:call(Custodian, ?MODULE, enrollment_wait_generation,
  232:                         [ApplicantAuthor, Ref, First], 20000),
  233:     {ok, HostBlob} = quod_node_actor:reference(HostNs, HostAnchor, <<"me.">>, 3),
  234:     HostAuthor = {node_actor, HostBlob},
  235:     {ok, HostFirst} = peer:call(Applicant, ?MODULE, enrollment_wait_generation,
  236:                               [HostAuthor, Host, none], 20000),
  237:     {ok, BeforeRestart} = peer:call(Applicant, ?MODULE, enrollment_wait_generation,
  238:                         [HostAuthor, Host, HostFirst], 20000),
  239:     HostKey = ?config(target_pub, Config),
  240:     #{control_links := BeforeLinks} = peer:call(Applicant,
  241:         quod_directory_control, test_control_state, []),
  242:     {_, OldLink, _} = maps:get(HostKey, BeforeLinks),
  243:     %% The transport survives a directory-only restart. Its peer-opened
  244:     %% streams must reset so the new owner acquires fresh subscriptions.
  245:     ok = peer:call(Custodian, supervisor, terminate_child,
  246:         [quod_reg:via({sup, node}), quod_directory_control]),
  247:     {ok, _} = peer:call(Custodian, supervisor, restart_child,
  248:         [quod_reg:via({sup, node}), quod_directory_control]),
  249:     {ok, Recovered} = peer:call(Applicant, ?MODULE, enrollment_wait_generation,
  250:         [HostAuthor, Host, BeforeRestart], 20000),
  251:     #{control_links := AfterLinks} = peer:call(Applicant,
  252:         quod_directory_control, test_control_state, []),
  253:     {_, NewLink, _} = maps:get(HostKey, AfterLinks),
  254:     ?assertNotEqual(OldLink, NewLink),
  255:     #{subscribers := Subscribers} = peer:call(Custodian,
  256:         quod_directory_control, test_control_state, []),
  257:     %% The source peer may also subscribe to this root custodian. Require
  258:     %% exactly one stream per peer, including the restarted applicant link.
  259:     SubscriberKeys = [Key || {Key, _} <- maps:values(Subscribers)],
  260:     ApplicantKey = ?config(third_pub, Config),
  261:     ?assertEqual([ApplicantKey], [Key || Key <- SubscriberKeys, Key =:= ApplicantKey]),
  262:     ?assertEqual(lists:sort(SubscriberKeys), lists:usort(SubscriberKeys)),
  263:     ?assertMatch(#{control_link_count := 1},
  264:         peer:call(Applicant, quod_directory_control, stats, [])),
  265:     {ok, _} = peer:call(Applicant, ?MODULE, enrollment_wait_generation,
  266:         [HostAuthor, Host, Recovered], 20000).

  268: enrollment_local_evidence_cost(Identity, Sources) ->
  269:     Owner = quod_reg:where({foreign_log, node}),
  270:     Calls = [{quod_foreign_log, fetch_evidence, 9},
  271:              {quod_foreign_log, resident_current_identity, 3},
  272:              {quod_ledger_store, open_ro_snapshot, 1},
  273:              {quod_ledger_store, open, 3}, {quod_ledger_store, open_ro, 3},
  274:              {quod_ledger_store, fold, 5}, {quod_ledger_store, fold_groups, 3},
  275:              {quod_ledger_store, batch_sync, 1}, {file, datasync, 1}],
  276:     lists:foreach(fun(MFA) -> 1 = erlang:trace_pattern(MFA, true, [local]) end, Calls),
  277:     1 = erlang:trace(Owner, true, [call, set_on_spawn, {tracer, self()}]),
  278:     try
  279:         {ok, A} = quod_foreign_log:current(Sources, Identity, 5000),
  280:         {ok, B} = quod_foreign_log:current(Sources, Identity, 5000),
  281:         ?assertEqual(maps:get(slot, A), maps:get(slot, B)),
  282:         Barrier = erlang:trace_delivered(all),
  283:         receive {trace_delivered, all, Barrier} -> ok after 5000 -> error(trace_timeout) end,
  284:         Events = enrollment_evidence_events([]),
  285:         {ok, SelfKey} = application:get_env(quod, node_pubkey),
  286:         Probes = lists:usort([Pid || {Pid, {quod_foreign_log, fetch_evidence,
  287:             [_, _, Peer, _, I | _]}} <- Events, Peer =:= SelfKey, I =:= Identity]),
  288:         ?assert(length(Probes) >= 1),
  289:         ?assertEqual(2, length([ok || {Pid, {quod_foreign_log, resident_current_identity,
  290:             [_, I, _]}} <- Events, Pid =:= Owner, I =:= Identity])),
  291:         Reads = [MFA || {Pid, MFA} <- Events, lists:member(Pid, Probes)],
  292:         ?assertEqual(length(Probes), length([ok || {quod_ledger_store, open_ro_snapshot, _} <- Reads])),
  293:         ?assertEqual([], [MFA || {_, {M, F, _} = MFA} <- Events,
  294:             M =/= quod_foreign_log, {M, F} =/= {quod_ledger_store, open_ro_snapshot}]),
  295:         #{checks => 2, slot => maps:get(slot, B), local_probes => length(Probes),
  296:           archive_rebuilds_or_writes => 0}
  297:     after
  298:         erlang:trace(Owner, false, [call, set_on_spawn]),
  299:         lists:foreach(fun(MFA) -> erlang:trace_pattern(MFA, false, [local]) end, Calls)
  300:     end.
  301: 
  302: enrollment_evidence_events(Acc) ->
  303:     receive {trace, Pid, call, MFA} -> enrollment_evidence_events([{Pid, MFA} | Acc])
  304:     after 0 -> Acc end.
  305: 
  306: enrollment_wait_generation(Author, Ref, After) ->
  307:     true = quod_reg:subscribe_tracked({node_identity_route, Ref}),
  308:     try enrollment_wait_generation(Author, Ref, After, quod_time:mono_ms() + 15000)
  309:     after quod_reg:unsubscribe_tracked({node_identity_route, Ref}) end.
  310: 
  311: enrollment_wait_generation(Author, Ref, After, Deadline) ->
  312:     case ets:lookup(quod_directory_highwater, Author) of
  313:         [{Author, Epoch, Number}] when {Epoch, Number} > After; After =:= none ->
  314:             {ok, {Epoch, Number}};
  315:         _ -> receive
  316:             {node_identity_route_changed, _, Ref} ->
  317:                 enrollment_wait_generation(Author, Ref, After, Deadline)
  318:         after max(0, Deadline - quod_time:mono_ms()) ->
  319:             error({generation_not_received, Author, After, quod_directory_control:stats()})
  320:         end
  321:     end.
  322: 
  323: enrollment_wait_complete() ->
  324:     Manager = quod_reg:where({namespace_manager, node}), Parent = self(),
  325:     Observer = fun(State, {in, {node_enrollment_result, _, Result}}, _) ->
  326:                        Parent ! {enrollment_progress, Result}, State;
  327:                   (State, _, _) -> State end,
  328:     ok = sys:install(Manager, {Observer, enrollment_test}),
  329:     try
  330:         ok = quod_namespace_manager:enroll_node(),
  331:         enrollment_wait_complete(quod_time:mono_ms() + 45000)
  332:     after sys:remove(Manager, Observer) end.
  333: 
  334: enrollment_wait_complete(Deadline) ->
  335:     case maps:get(node_enrollment, quod_namespace_manager:stats()) of
  336:         complete -> ok;
  337:         {error, Reason} -> error({enrollment_failed, Reason});
  338:         _ -> receive
  339:             {enrollment_progress, _} -> enrollment_wait_complete(Deadline)
  340:         after max(0, Deadline - quod_time:mono_ms()) ->
  341:             error({enrollment_incomplete, quod_namespace_manager:stats()})
  342:         end
  343:     end.
  344: 
  345: %% These suite peers retain directory high-water marks across cases. Advance
  346: %% the synthetic author's epoch even when a preceding recovery case expired
  347: %% all its routes; never weaken the directory's stale-generation rejection.
  348: enrollment_route(Peer, Key, Endpoint, Hosted) ->
  349:     Author = {root_bootstrap, Key, Key},
  350:     Previous = peer:call(Peer, ets, lookup, [quod_directory_highwater, Author]),
  351:     Epoch = case Previous of [] -> 1; [{Author, E, _}] -> E + 1 end,
  352:     {ok, _} = peer:call(Peer, quod_ct, install_directory_generation,
  353:                         [Key, Endpoint, Hosted, Epoch, 1]),
  354:     ok.
  355: 
  356: enrollment_wait_ready(Ns, Goal) ->
  357:     true = quod_reg:subscribe({runtime, Ns}),
  358:     try enrollment_wait_ready(Ns, Goal, quod_time:mono_ms() + 10000)
  359:     after quod_reg:unsubscribe({runtime, Ns}) end.
  360: 
  361: enrollment_wait_ready(Ns, Goal, Deadline) ->
  362:     case quod_prolog:prove_ro(Ns, Goal) of
  363:         {ok, [_], _} -> ok;
  364:         _ -> receive
  365:             {proof_ready, {Ns, _}, _, _, _} -> enrollment_wait_ready(Ns, Goal, Deadline);
  366:             {replay_ready, {Ns, _}, _} -> enrollment_wait_ready(Ns, Goal, Deadline)
  367:         after max(0, Deadline - quod_time:mono_ms()) -> error({enrollment_not_ready, Ns})
  368:         end
  369:     end.
  370: 
  371: remote_signed_transaction_savepoints(Config) ->
  372:     ok = require_third_route_at_target(Config),
  373:     %% Fresh callable names cannot be made accidentally executable by a
  374:     %% previously loaded test beam or another proof's atom allocation.
  375:     Suffix = integer_to_binary(erlang:unique_integer([positive])),
  376:     Removed = <<"tx_wire_removed_", Suffix/binary>>,
  377:     Kept = <<"tx_wire_kept_", Suffix/binary>>,
  378:     LocalChoices = <<"tx_wire_local_choices_", Suffix/binary>>,
  379:     Setup = iolist_to_binary(["animals::(assertz(", LocalChoices,
  380:       "(0)), assertz((", LocalChoices, "(N) :- N > 0, M is N - 1, "
  381:       "((assertz(", Removed, "(N)), fail); \\+ ", Removed, "(N)), ",
  382:       LocalChoices, "(M))))."]),
  383:     ?assertMatch({ok, _, {normalized, {committed, [_], _}}},
  384:                  submit_signed_execute(Config, Setup)),
  385:     Failed = iolist_to_binary(["animals::(transaction((assertz(", Removed,
  386:       "(1)), third::assertz(", Removed, "(1)), fail)); true)."]),
  387:     ?assertMatch({ok, _, {normalized, {answers, _, [_]}}},
  388:                  submit_signed_execute(Config, Failed)),
  389:     Fallback = iolist_to_binary(["animals::transaction((third::true, ",
  390:       LocalChoices, "(1200), ((assertz(", Removed,
  391:       "(2)), third::assertz(", Removed, "(2)), fail); (assertz(", Kept,
  392:       "(3)), ", LocalChoices, "(1200), third::assertz(", Kept, "(3))))))."]),
  393:     ?assertMatch({ok, _, {normalized, {committed, [_], {group_outcome, _, _, _}}}},
  394:                  submit_signed_execute(Config, Fallback)),
  395:     lists:foreach(fun({Peer, Ns}) ->
  396:         RemoveAtom = peer:call(Peer, erlang, binary_to_existing_atom, [Removed, utf8]),
  397:         KeepAtom = peer:call(Peer, erlang, binary_to_existing_atom, [Kept, utf8]),
  398:         ?assertMatch({fail, _}, peer:call(Peer, quod_prolog, prove, [Ns, {RemoveAtom, {'X'}}])),
  399:         ?assertMatch({ok, [_], _}, peer:call(Peer, quod_prolog, prove, [Ns, {KeepAtom, 3}]))
  400:     end, [{?config(target, Config), ?NS}, {?config(third, Config), ?THIRD_NS}]).
  401: 
  402: cut_findall_local_and_cohosted(Config) ->
  403:     Peer = ?config(target, Config),
  404:     X = {'X'}, Choices = {';', {'=', X, 1}, {'=', X, 2}},
  405:     lists:foreach(fun(Inner) ->
  406:         Goal = {findall, X, {';', {',', Inner, '!'}, {'=', X, 3}}, {'L'}},
  407:         ?assertMatch({ok, [#{'L' := [1]}], _},
  408:                      peer:call(Peer, quod_prolog, prove, [?NS, Goal], 60000))
  409:     end, [Choices, {'::', ?FOURTH_NS, Choices}]).
  410: 
  411: cut_findall_remote_boundaries(Config) ->
  412:     Peer = ?config(asker, Config),
  413:     X = {'X'}, Choices = {';', {'=', X, 1}, {'=', X, 2}},
  414:     Remote = {'::', ?NS, Choices},
  415:     Cases = [
  416:       {{';', Remote, {'=', X, 3}}, [1, 2, 3]},
  417:       {{';', {'::', ?NS, {',', Choices, '!'}}, {'=', X, 3}}, [1, 3]},
  418:       {{';', {',', Remote, '!'}, {'=', X, 3}}, [1]},
  419:       {{';', {',', {'::', ?NS, {'\\+', {',', '!', fail}}}, {'=', X, 1}},
  420:                {'=', X, 3}}, [1, 3]},
  421:       {{'::', ?NS, {';', {'->', {',', '!', fail}, {'=', X, 1}},
  422:                               {'=', X, 2}}}, [2]}],
  423:     lists:foreach(fun({Inner, Expected}) ->
  424:         Goal = {findall, X, Inner, {'L'}},
  425:         ?assertMatch({ok, [#{'L' := Expected}], _},
  426:                      peer:call(Peer, quod_prolog, prove, [?ASKER_NS, Goal], 60000))
  427:     end, Cases).
  428: 
  429: cut_findall_signed_multiscope_savepoints(Config) ->
  430:     ok = require_third_route_at_target(Config),
  431:     %% Genuine signed requests and target commits, not an intent or overlay
  432:     %% shortcut. Ordinary collection retains staged writes; transaction
  433:     %% checkpoints remove failed-candidate writes on both remote scopes.
  434:     ?assertMatch({ok, _, {normalized, {committed, [_], {group_outcome, _, _, _}}}},
  435:       submit_signed_execute(Config,
  436:         <<"animals::findall(X, ((X=1;X=2), assertz(cut_keep(X)), third::assertz(cut_keep(X)), !), [1]).">>)),
  437:     Rollback = submit_signed_execute(Config,
  438:         <<"animals::((transaction((findall(X, ((X=1;X=2), assertz(cut_remove(X)), third::assertz(cut_remove(X)), !), [1]), fail))); X=rolled_back).">>),
  439:     ?assertMatch({ok, _, {normalized, {answers, _, [_]}}}, Rollback),
  440:     {ok, _, {normalized, {answers, _, [RollbackBinding]}}} = Rollback,
  441:     ?assertEqual({ok, [{<<"X">>, rolled_back}]}, quod_durable_term:decode_result(RollbackBinding)),
  442:     lists:foreach(fun({Peer, Ns}) ->
  443:         ?assertMatch({ok, [_], _}, peer:call(Peer, quod_prolog, prove, [Ns, {cut_keep, 1}])),
  444:         ?assertMatch({fail, _}, peer:call(Peer, quod_prolog, prove, [Ns, {cut_keep, 2}])),
  445:         ?assertMatch({fail, _}, peer:call(Peer, quod_prolog, prove, [Ns, {cut_remove, {'X'}}]))
  446:     end, [{?config(target, Config), ?NS}, {?config(third, Config), ?THIRD_NS}]).
  447: 
  448: init_per_suite(Config) ->
  449:     {TargetPub, _} = TargetKey = quod_identity:generate(),
  450:     {AskerPub, _} = AskerKey = quod_identity:generate(),
  451:     {ThirdPub, _} = ThirdKey = key_before(TargetPub),
  452:     {AgentPub, _} = AgentKey = quod_identity:generate(),
  453:     TargetAddr = {"127.0.0.1", ?TARGET_PORT},
  454:     AskerAddr = {"127.0.0.1", ?ASKER_PORT},
  455:     ThirdAddr = {"127.0.0.1", ?THIRD_PORT},
  456:     Animals = filename:join(code:priv_dir(quod), "ontologies/animals.pl"),
  457:     Pets = filename:join(code:priv_dir(quod), "ontologies/pets.pl"),
  458:     {ok, AnimalsBin} = file:read_file(Animals),
  459:     {ok, PetsBin} = file:read_file(Pets),
  460:     FilterSymbolName =
  461:         <<"quod_r4_target_only_",
  462:           (binary:encode_hex(crypto:strong_rand_bytes(8)))/binary>>,
  463:     TargetGenesis = filename:join(?config(priv_dir, Config), "remote_animals.pl"),
  464:     ok = file:write_file(
  465:            TargetGenesis,
  466:            ["can_invoke(_Goal, agent_instance_ref(<<\"pets\">>, _, "
  467:             "human_user(test_agent)), _Chain, _Ns).\n",
  468:             AnimalsBin,
  469:             "\necho(X).\n",
  470:             FilterSymbolName, "(opaque).\n",
  471:             "blocked(X) :- fail_with_reason(impossible_to_link(X)).\n",
  472:             "via_third_failure :- third::third_blocked.\n",
  473:             "via_fourth(X) :- third::via_fourth(X).\n",
  474:             "dtx_write_chain(X) :- assertz(dtx_animals_mark(X)), "
  475:             "third::dtx_write(X).\n",
  476:             dtx_disjoint_target_rules(),
  477:             "conflict_version(0).\n"
  478:             "dtx_conflicting_write(X) :- conflict_version(_), "
  479:             "retract(conflict_version(0)), assertz(conflict_version(X)), "
  480:             "assertz(dtx_conflict_mark(X)), third::dtx_write(X).\n",
  481:             deep_failure_rules(),
  482:             "loop :- loop.\n"]),
  483:     TargetAllow = #{?ASKER_NS => [AskerPub],
  484:                     ?THIRD_NS => [ThirdPub]},
  485:     Target = start_node(target, ?TARGET_PORT, TargetKey, ?NS,
  486:                         TargetGenesis, [], TargetAllow, Config),
  487:     ThirdGenesis = filename:join(?config(priv_dir, Config), "remote_third.pl"),
  488:     ok = file:write_file(
  489:            ThirdGenesis,
  490:            ["can_invoke(_Goal, _Principal, _Chain, _Ns).\n"
  491:             "third_blocked :- fail_with_reason(third_declined).\n"
  492:             "via_fourth(X) :- fourth::leaf(X).\n"
  493:             "dtx_write(X) :- assertz(dtx_third_mark(X)).\n",
  494:             dtx_disjoint_third_rules()]),
  495:     ThirdAllow = #{?ASKER_NS => [AskerPub],
  496:                    ?NS => [TargetPub]},
  497:     Third = start_node(third, ?THIRD_PORT, ThirdKey, ?THIRD_NS,
  498:                        ThirdGenesis, [], ThirdAllow, Config),
  499:     FourthGenesis = filename:join(
  500:                       ?config(priv_dir, Config), "remote_fourth.pl"),
  501:     ok = file:write_file(
  502:            FourthGenesis,
  503:            ["can_invoke(_Goal, _Principal, _Chain, _Ns).\n"
  504:             "leaf(ok).\n"]),
  505:     start_namespace(
  506:       Target, TargetPub, ?FOURTH_NS, FourthGenesis, [], Config),
  507:     PrivateGenesis = filename:join(?config(priv_dir, Config), "remote_private.pl"),
  508:     %% Policy belongs in GENESIS. `can_invoke/4` gates every scope entry —
  509:     %% including a top-level prove on this node — so an ontology born without a
  510:     %% clause could never be given one: it would deny the very proof that would
  511:     %% assert its policy. An empty chain is this host's own entry, which is
  512:     %% allowed so the ontology is usable at all; the restrictive clauses for
  513:     %% remote callers are asserted through it below.
  514:     ok = file:write_file(
  515:            PrivateGenesis,
  516:            ["can_join(_Ns, _Addr, Pk) :- peer_ready(Pk).\n",
  517:             "can_invoke(_Goal, _Principal, [], _Ns).\n",
  518:             "secret(42).\n"
  519:             "hidden(99).\n"]),
  520:     start_namespace(Target, TargetPub, ?PRIVATE_NS, PrivateGenesis, [], Config),
  521:     start_root_namespace(Target, TargetPub, Config),
  522:     start_brahms(Target, ?NS, TargetAddr, []),
  523:     DirectoryAllow = #{?NS => [ThirdPub, TargetPub],
  524:                        ?THIRD_NS => [ThirdPub],
  525:                        ?ROOT_NS => [TargetPub]},
  526:     AskerGenesis = filename:join(?config(priv_dir, Config), "remote_pets.pl"),
  527:     AgentKeySource = prolog_binary_literal(AgentPub),
  528:     ok = file:write_file(
  529:            AskerGenesis,
  530:            ["agent_key(human_user(test_agent), ", AgentKeySource,
  531:             ", active).\n",
  532:             %% Only a goal which also writes A is locally authorized here.
  533:             %% Exact remote selectors deliberately have no matching A policy;
  534:             %% the target ontology alone must authorize its predicate.
  535:             "can_invoke((assertz(signed_pets_mark(_)), _), "
  536:             "agent_instance_ref(<<\"pets\">>, _, human_user(test_agent)), "
  537:             "_Chain, _Ns).\n",
  538:             "can_invoke((instance_of(pet, my_dog), _), "
  539:             "agent_instance_ref(<<\"pets\">>, _, human_user(test_agent)), "
  540:             "_Chain, _Ns).\n",
  541:             "can_invoke(independent(_), "
  542:             "agent_instance_ref(<<\"pets\">>, _, human_user(test_agent)), "
  543:             "_Chain, _Ns).\n"
  544:             "can_invoke((_;_), "
  545:             "agent_instance_ref(<<\"pets\">>, _, human_user(test_agent)), "
  546:             "_Chain, _Ns).\n",
  547:             PetsBin,
  548:             "\nrecover_third_failure :- animals::via_third_failure ; "
  549:             "get_fail_reasons([_, _, _, _, third_declined]).\n"]),
  550:     Asker = start_node(asker, ?ASKER_PORT, AskerKey, ?ASKER_NS,
  551:                        AskerGenesis,
  552:                        [TargetAddr], DirectoryAllow, Config),
  553:     TargetAnchor = peer:call(
  554:                      Target, quod_simplex, genesis_hash, [?NS]),
  555:     ThirdAnchor = peer:call(
  556:                     Third, quod_simplex, genesis_hash, [?THIRD_NS]),
  557:     FourthAnchor = peer:call(
  558:                      Target, quod_simplex, genesis_hash, [?FOURTH_NS]),
  559:     AskerAnchor = peer:call(
  560:                      Asker, quod_simplex, genesis_hash, [?ASKER_NS]),
  561:     RootAnchor = peer:call(
  562:                    Target, quod_simplex, genesis_hash, [?ROOT_NS]),
  563:     NetworkId = RootAnchor,
  564:     lists:foreach(
  565:       fun(Peer) -> set_network_identity(Peer, NetworkId) end,
  566:       [Target, Asker, Third]),
  567:     %% Root's seed/spec requires a local replica before durable effects.
  568:     %% The old fixture declared its anchor as locally desired on every peer
  569:     %% but left Asker/Third without the corresponding owner. R2 correctly
  570:     %% treats that as unavailable local history, never as foreign permission.
  571:     %% Pin the refusal, then establish real non-voting replicas. Root writes
  572:     %% and effect custody still execute on Target, its sole validator.
  573:     start_brahms(Target, ?ROOT_NS, TargetAddr, []),
  574:     lists:foreach(fun({RootPeer, RootPub, RootAddr}) ->
  575:         ?assertEqual(undefined,
  576:             peer:call(RootPeer, quod_reg, where, [{quod_simplex, ?ROOT_NS}])),
  577:         RootDeadline = peer:call(RootPeer, quod_time, mono_ms, []) + 1000,
  578:         ?assertEqual({error, not_ready}, peer:call(RootPeer, quod_simplex,
  579:             history_view_at, [{?ROOT_NS, RootAnchor}, 1, RootDeadline])),
  580:         start_join_namespace(RootPeer, RootPub, ?ROOT_NS, RootAnchor, [TargetAddr], Config),
  581:         start_brahms(RootPeer, ?ROOT_NS, RootAddr, [TargetAddr]),
  582:         wait_ready(RootPeer, ?ROOT_NS, {effect_custody_limits, 64, unlimited}),
  583:         ?assertMatch(#{role := observer},
  584:             peer:call(RootPeer, quod_simplex, status, [?ROOT_NS]))
  585:     end, [{Asker, AskerPub, AskerAddr}, {Third, ThirdPub, ThirdAddr}]),
  586:     %% The third node is a real, fully synchronized observer of `animals`.
  587:     %% Its key sorts before the sole validator so the live selection tests
  588:     %% below would choose it first if advertised roles were trusted.
  589:     ok = peer:call(Third, quod_quic, learn, [TargetPub, TargetAddr]),
  590:     ok = peer:call(Target, quod_quic, learn, [ThirdPub, ThirdAddr]),
  591:     start_join_namespace(
  592:       Third, ThirdPub, ?NS, TargetAnchor, [TargetAddr], Config),
  593:     start_brahms(Third, ?NS, ThirdAddr, [TargetAddr]),
  594:     AgentRef = {agent_instance_ref, ?ASKER_NS, AskerAnchor,
  595:                 {human_user, test_agent}},
  596:     {ok, _} = peer:call(
  597:                 Asker, quod_ct, install_directory_generation,
  598:                 [TargetPub, TargetAddr,
  599:                  [{?NS, TargetAnchor, validator},
  600:                   {?FOURTH_NS, FourthAnchor, validator},
  601:                   {?ROOT_NS, RootAnchor, validator}], 1, 1]),
  602:     %% Start with the controller-relay topology. Atomic commit cases establish
  603:     %% B's C route explicitly: Resolve verifies every role's certified Vote,
  604:     %% not just the origin's. Scope selection itself remains owned by A.
  605:     {ok, _} = peer:call(
  606:                 Asker, quod_ct, install_directory_generation,
  607:                 [ThirdPub, ThirdAddr,
  608:                  [{?THIRD_NS, ThirdAnchor, validator},
  609:                   {?NS, TargetAnchor, observer}], 1, 1]),
  610:     {ok, _} = peer:call(
  611:                 Third, quod_ct, install_directory_generation,
  612:                 [TargetPub, TargetAddr,
  613:                  [{?NS, TargetAnchor, validator}], 1, 1]),
  614:     {ok, _} = peer:call(
  615:                 Target, quod_ct, install_directory_generation,
  616:                 [AskerPub, AskerAddr,
  617:                  [{?ASKER_NS, AskerAnchor, validator}], 1, 1]),
  618:     {ok, _} = peer:call(
  619:                 Third, quod_ct, install_directory_generation,
  620:                 [AskerPub, AskerAddr,
  621:                  [{?ASKER_NS, AskerAnchor, validator}], 1, 1]),
  622:     %% Private reachability is the local projection of an exact committed
  623:     %% HostNodeRef.  The target ontology's public route supplies that host's
  624:     %% current endpoint; the private ontology itself is never advertised.
  625:     PrivateAnchor = peer:call(
  626:                       Target, quod_simplex, genesis_hash, [?PRIVATE_NS]),
  627:     HostNodeRef = {agent_instance_ref, ?NS, TargetAnchor, target_node},
  628:     ok = peer:call(
  629:            Asker, quod_directory, install_private_projection,
  630:            [[#{namespace => ?PRIVATE_NS, anchor => PrivateAnchor,
  631:                host_node_ref => HostNodeRef}]]),
  632:     %% The origin, not the currently executing B scope, selects C for A→B→C.
  633:     %% B therefore has no C route; this exercises the authenticated controller
  634:     %% relay and target-only atom materialization path.
  635:     %% C was installed above through the same candidate path.
  636:     start_brahms(Asker, ?ASKER_NS, AskerAddr, [TargetAddr]),
  637:     start_brahms(Third, ?THIRD_NS, ThirdAddr, []),
  638:     %% Root's ordinary Prolog policy, not the transport fixture, grants this
  639:     %% exact durable agent permission to create an ontology.  The signed
  640:     %% remote-effect case below must still pass Root's normal can_invoke and
  641:     %% can_create_ontology rules.
  642:     ?assertMatch(
  643:        {ok, [_], _},
  644:        peer:call(
  645:          Target, quod_prolog, prove,
  646:          [?ROOT_NS, {assertz, {ontology_creator_agent, AgentRef}}],
  647:          60000)),
  648:     AuthPid = peer:call(Asker, erlang, whereis, [quod_client_auth]),
  649:     true = is_pid(AuthPid),
  650:     ClientPeer = {127, 0, 0, 1},
  651:     Session = open_client_session(
  652:                 Asker, NetworkId, AskerPub, AgentKey, ClientPeer),
  653:     wait_ready(Target, ?NS, {diet, dog, kibble}),
  654:     wait_ready(Third, ?NS, {diet, dog, kibble}),
  655:     wait_ready(Target, ?PRIVATE_NS, {secret, 42}),
  656:     wait_ready(Third, ?THIRD_NS,
  657:                {can_invoke, probe, anonymous, [], ?THIRD_NS}),
  658:     wait_ready(Asker, ?ASKER_NS, {instance_of, pet, my_dog}),
  659:     %% `can_invoke/4` receives the authenticated principal and the whole
  660:     %% origin-built chain at once, so a restrictive policy names both itself.
  661:     %% `secret/1` admits the real node key; `hidden/1` deliberately names a
  662:     %% different one, so the negative case still proves that an ontology name
  663:     %% in the chain cannot launder its transport.
  664:     ACLs = [
  665:         {assertz, {can_invoke, {secret, {'X'}}, {node, AskerPub},
  666:                    {'_'}, ?PRIVATE_NS}},
  667:         {assertz, {can_invoke, {hidden, {'X'}}, {node, <<0:256>>},
  668:                    {'_'}, ?PRIVATE_NS}}
  669:     ],
  670:     lists:foreach(
  671:       fun(ACL) ->
  672:           ?assertMatch({ok, [_], _},
  673:                        peer:call(Target, quod_prolog, prove,
  674:                                  [?PRIVATE_NS, ACL], 60000))
  675:       end, ACLs),
  676:     [{target, Target}, {asker, Asker}, {third, Third},
  677:      {target_pub, TargetPub}, {asker_pub, AskerPub},
  678:      {target_addr, TargetAddr}, {third_pub, ThirdPub},
  679:      {third_addr, ThirdAddr}, {network_id, NetworkId},
  680:      {target_anchor, TargetAnchor}, {third_anchor, ThirdAnchor},
  681:      {fourth_anchor, FourthAnchor},
  682:      {asker_anchor, AskerAnchor}, {filter_symbol_name, FilterSymbolName},
  683:      {agent_ref, AgentRef},
  684:      {agent_key, AgentKey}, {agent_pub, AgentPub},
  685:      {client_peer, ClientPeer}, {client_session, Session},
  686:      {client_auth, AuthPid} | Config].
  687: 
  688: end_per_suite(Config) ->
  689:     _ = [catch peer:stop(P) || P <- [?config(target, Config),
  690:                                       ?config(asker, Config),
  691:                                       ?config(third, Config)]],
  692:     ok.
  693: 
  694: %% A real, caught-up observer can answer the ontology locally, but an
  695: %% advertised observer row is never eligible to answer a single-host remote
  696: %% read. The sole current validator must own the live scope.
  697: remote_plain_read_excludes_live_observer(Config) ->
  698:     Asker = ?config(asker, Config),
  699:     Target = ?config(target, Config),
  700:     Observer = ?config(third, Config),
  701:     ObserverKey = ?config(third_pub, Config),
  702:     {known, Routes} = peer:call(Asker, quod_directory, resolve, [?NS]),
  703:     ?assert(lists:any(
  704:               fun(#{node_key := Key, role := observer}) ->
  705:                       Key =:= ObserverKey;
  706:                  (_) -> false
  707:               end, Routes)),
  708:     ?assertMatch(
  709:        {ok, [_], _},
  710:        peer:call(Observer, quod_prolog, prove_ro,
  711:                  [?NS, {diet, dog, kibble}], 5000)),
  712:     assert_symbol_opaque(Asker, ?config(filter_symbol_name, Config)),
  713:     AtomsBefore = peer:call(Asker, erlang, system_info, [atom_count]),
  714:     assert_remote_scope_owner(Asker, Target, Observer),
  715:     ?assertEqual(
  716:        AtomsBefore, peer:call(Asker, erlang, system_info, [atom_count])),
  717:     assert_symbol_opaque(Asker, ?config(filter_symbol_name, Config)).
  718: 
  719: %% Native preparation needs the selected physical host, including an observer.
  720: %% It uses the ordinary authenticated scope wire, in an isolated read-only
  721: %% context; it cannot supply ordinary material reads or execute the signed goal.
  722: remote_native_read_uses_selected_observer(Config) ->
  723:     Asker = ?config(asker,Config), Observer = ?config(third,Config),
  724:     Key = ?config(third_pub,Config), Identity = {?NS,?config(target_anchor,Config)},
  725:     ?assertMatch(#{role := observer},peer:call(Observer,quod_simplex,status,[?NS])),
  726:     {Bytes,Signature} = signed_goal_request(?config(network_id,Config),
  727:         ?config(agent_pub,Config),?config(agent_key,Config),?ASKER_NS,
  728:         ?config(asker_anchor,Config),quod_time:now_ms()+30000,execute,
  729:         <<"assertz(signed_pets_mark(987654321)).">>),
  730:     {ok,Evidence} = quod_client_goal:verify(Bytes,Signature),
  731:     Auth = quod_client_goal:request_auth(Evidence),
  732:     Read = fun(Target,Goal) ->
  733:         Deadline = peer:call(Asker,quod_time,mono_ms,[]) + 10000,
  734:         peer:call(Asker,quod_ask,native_read,[Key,Target,Goal,Auth,Deadline],15000)
  735:     end,
  736:     Operation = maps:get(operation_ref,Evidence),
  737:     Target = ?config(target,Config),
  738:     #{proves := ObserverBefore} = peer:call(Observer,quod_prolog,stats,[?NS]),
  739:     #{proves := TargetBefore} = peer:call(Target,quod_prolog,stats,[?NS]),
  740:     ?assertEqual({ok,{current_request_operation,Operation}},Read(Identity,{current_request_operation,Operation})),
  741:     ?assertEqual(ObserverBefore+1,maps:get(proves,peer:call(Observer,quod_prolog,stats,[?NS]))),
  742:     ?assertMatch(#{proves := TargetBefore},peer:call(Target,quod_prolog,stats,[?NS])),
  743:     %% Observer service does not acquire a plan signer.
  744:     ?assertMatch({fail,_},Read(Identity,{current_executor_key,Key})),
  745:     ?assertEqual({ok,{via_fourth,ok}},Read(Identity,{via_fourth,ok})),
  746:     ?assertMatch({error,_},Read(Identity,{assertz,native_scope_write})),
  747:     ?assertMatch({error,_},Read({?NS,<<0:256>>},true)),
  748:     ?assertMatch({fail,_},peer:call(Observer,quod_prolog,prove_ro,[?NS,native_scope_write])),
  749:     assert_fact_absent(Asker,?ASKER_NS,signed_pets_mark,987654321).

  752: %% GUI material owners remain on Asker; its native receiver is a separate node
  753: %% serving only an observer replica of the GUI capability. No Human replica or
  754: %% responder is installed on that connection host.
  755: remote_gui_opening_observer_receiver(Config) ->
  756:     Owner = ?config(asker,Config), Receiver = ?config(third,Config),
  757:     OwnerKey = ?config(asker_pub,Config), ReceiverKey = ?config(third_pub,Config),
  758:     OwnerAddr = {"127.0.0.1",?ASKER_PORT}, ReceiverAddr = {"127.0.0.1",?THIRD_PORT},
  759:     Source = fun(Name) -> quod_prolog:read_terms(filename:join(code:priv_dir(quod),"ontologies/" ++ Name)) end,
  760:     Start = fun(Ns,Terms,Modules) ->
  761:         Dir = filename:join(?config(priv_dir,Config),binary_to_list(Ns)),
  762:         {_,_} = peer:call(Owner,quod_lobby_tests,start_namespace,[Ns,#{node_id => OwnerKey,
  763:             mode => create,data_dir => Dir,external_predicate_modules => Modules,
  764:             genesis_diff => quod_prolog:terms_to_diff(Terms)}],15000),
  765:         peer:call(Owner,quod_simplex,genesis_hash,[Ns])
  766:     end,
  767:     GuiNs = <<"quod:gui">>, NodeNs = <<"gui:remote-node">>, AppNs = <<"gui:remote-app">>,
  768:     GuiAnchor = Start(GuiNs,Source("quod_gui.pl") ++ [{can_invoke,true,{'_'},{'_'},GuiNs}],
  769:                       [quod_agent_predicates,quod_gui_predicates]),
  770:     start_brahms(Owner,GuiNs,OwnerAddr,[]),
  771:     start_join_namespace(Receiver,ReceiverKey,GuiNs,GuiAnchor,[OwnerAddr],Config),
  772:     start_brahms(Receiver,GuiNs,ReceiverAddr,[OwnerAddr]),
  773:     ok = peer:call(Receiver,?MODULE,enrollment_wait_ready,[GuiNs,true],15000),
  774:     ?assertMatch(#{role := observer},peer:call(Receiver,quod_simplex,status,[GuiNs])),
  775:     HumanNs = <<"gui:remote-human">>, HumanInstance = {human_user,test_agent},
  776:     HumanAnchor = Start(HumanNs,Source("gui_hud.pl") ++ [
  777:         {agent_key,HumanInstance,?config(agent_pub,Config),active},
  778:         {instance_of,human_user,HumanInstance},{gui_pending_allowance,HumanInstance,2},
  779:         {can_invoke,{'_'},{agent_instance_ref,HumanNs,{'_'},HumanInstance},{'_'},HumanNs}],
  780:         [quod_agent_predicates]),
  781:     Human = {agent_instance_ref,HumanNs,HumanAnchor,HumanInstance},
  782:     Ctx = #{agent => {HumanNs,HumanAnchor},key_pair => ?config(agent_key,Config),
  783:             network => ?config(network_id,Config)},
  784:     Admin = {can_invoke,{'_'},Human,{'_'},{'_'}},
  785:     NodeAnchor = Start(NodeNs,Source("node_execution.pl") ++ [Admin,
  786:         {node_ontology,NodeNs},{instance_of,node,physical_node},{agent_key,physical_node,OwnerKey,active}],[]),
  787:     Node = {agent_instance_ref,NodeNs,NodeAnchor,physical_node},
  788:     {ok,NodeBlob} = quod_wire_term:encode_canonical(Node),
  789:     Saved = peer:call(Owner,application,get_env,[quod,node_actor_principal]),
  790:     ok = peer:call(Owner,application,set_env,[quod,node_actor_principal,{agent,NodeBlob}]),
  791:     Unlock = filename:join(?config(priv_dir,Config),"remote-gui-unlock"),
  792:     ok = quod_file:write_atomic(Unlock,crypto:strong_rand_bytes(32),8#600),
  793:     VaultConfig = #{directory => filename:join(?config(priv_dir,Config),"remote-gui-keys"),unlock_file => Unlock},
  794:     ok = peer:call(Owner,application,set_env,[quod,agent_vault,VaultConfig]),
  795:     {ok,_} = peer:call(Owner,supervisor,restart_child,[quod_reg:via({sup,node}),quod_agent_vault]),
  796:     AppAnchor = Start(AppNs,Source("agent_instance.pl") ++ Source("gui_question.pl") ++
  797:         Source("gui_instance.pl") ++ quod_prolog:read_terms(filename:join([
  798:             filename:dirname(code:which(?MODULE)),"fixtures","gui-components.pl"])) ++ [Admin,
  799:         {gui_vocabulary,GuiNs,GuiAnchor},{gui_pending_allowance,actor,2},{gui_completion_allowance,actor,30000},
  800:         {can_assign_agent_host,Human,actor,none,0,Node,{'_'}},
  801:         {':-',{settings_entered,{'N'},{'M'},{'L'},{'A'}},{assertz,{saved,{'N'},{'M'},{'L'},{'A'}}}}],
  802:         [quod_agent_predicates,quod_agent_work_predicates]),
  803:     Actor = {agent_instance_ref,AppNs,AppAnchor,actor},
  804:     Ref = {form_ref,AppNs,AppAnchor,settings},
  805:     Scope = fun(Ns,Anchor,Goal) -> {'::',Ns,{',',{current_ontology_identity,Ns,Anchor},Goal}} end,
  806:     Submit = fun(Goal) -> peer:call(Owner,quod_lobby_tests,submit,[Ctx,execute,Goal],60000) end,
  807:     {ok,ActorBlob} = quod_wire_term:encode_canonical(Actor),
  808:     {ok,Key} = peer:call(Owner,quod_agent_vault,prepare,[ActorBlob,0]),
  809:     ok = peer:call(Owner,?MODULE,gui_host_actor,[Ctx,Actor,Node,Key],30000),
  810:     lists:foreach(fun(Term) ->
  811:         ?assertMatch({ok,_,{normalized,{committed,_,_}}},Submit(Scope(AppNs,AppAnchor,{assertz,Term})))
  812:     end,[{gui_question_policy,settings,Human,Actor},{gui_responder_policy,actor,Ref,Human}]),
  813:     ok = enrollment_route(Receiver,OwnerKey,OwnerAddr,
  814:         [{?ASKER_NS,?config(asker_anchor,Config),validator},
  815:          {HumanNs,HumanAnchor,validator},{GuiNs,GuiAnchor,validator},
  816:          {NodeNs,NodeAnchor,validator},{AppNs,AppAnchor,validator}]),
  817:     ok = enrollment_route(Owner,ReceiverKey,ReceiverAddr,
  818:         [{?THIRD_NS,?config(third_anchor,Config),validator},{?NS,?config(target_anchor,Config),observer},
  819:          {GuiNs,GuiAnchor,observer}]),
  820:     ?assertEqual(undefined,peer:call(Receiver,quod_reg,where,[{quod_prolog,HumanNs}])),
  821:     ?assertEqual(undefined,peer:call(Receiver,quod_reg,where,[{quod_prolog,AppNs}])),
  822:     ?assertMatch({ok,[#{<<"V0">> := []}],_},peer:call(Receiver,quod_lobby_tests,read,
  823:         [Ctx,Scope(HumanNs,HumanAnchor,{gui_pending_questions,{0}})],20000)),
  824:     Client = peer:call(Receiver,?MODULE,gui_receiver_start,[Ctx,HumanNs,HumanAnchor]),
  825:     ReceiverCall = fun(Command) -> peer:call(Receiver,gen_server,call,[Client,Command,20000],25000) end,
  826:     try
  827:         #{<<"receiver">> := #{<<"token">> := TokenText}} = ReceiverCall(renew),
  828:         Token = base64:decode(TokenText,#{mode => urlsafe,padding => false}),
  829:         ?assertMatch({ok,_,{normalized,{committed,_,_}}},
  830:             Submit({gui_select_receiver,HumanInstance,ReceiverKey,Token})),
  831:         _ = ReceiverCall(renew),
  832:         ?assertMatch({ok,_,{normalized,{committed,_,_}}},Submit(Scope(AppNs,AppAnchor,{gui_open,settings,{0}}))),
  833:         ok = ReceiverCall(activated),
  834:         {ok,[#{<<"V0">> := [{question_ref,AppNs,AppAnchor,Q}]}],_} =
  835:             peer:call(Owner,quod_lobby_tests,read,[Ctx,{gui_pending_questions,{0}}]),
  836:         {ok,[#{<<"V0">> := Revision}],_} = peer:call(Owner,quod_lobby_tests,read,
  837:             [Ctx,Scope(AppNs,AppAnchor,{gui_schema,settings,{0},{'_'}})]),
  838:         Fields = [{field,name,<<"Remote">>},{field,mode,square},{field,level,75},{field,angle,180}],
  839:         ok = peer:call(Owner,?MODULE,gui_complete_answer,
  840:             [Ctx,Actor,Q,Scope(AppNs,AppAnchor,{gui_submit,Q,Revision,apply,Fields})],30000),
  841:         ?assertMatch({ok,[_],_},peer:call(Owner,quod_lobby_tests,read,
  842:             [Ctx,Scope(AppNs,AppAnchor,{saved,<<"Remote">>,square,75,180})])),
  843:         #{<<"value">> := <<"[]">>} = ReceiverCall(renew),
  844:         ok = ReceiverCall(stop),
  845:         %% The signed route remains, but the authoritative remote receiver is
  846:         %% absent. Public opening fails and creates no question or HUD row.
  847:         ?assertMatch({ok,_,{normalized,{failed,_}}},Submit(Scope(AppNs,AppAnchor,{gui_open,settings,{0}}))),
  848:         ?assertMatch({ok,[#{<<"V0">> := []}],_},peer:call(Owner,quod_lobby_tests,read,
  849:             [Ctx,{gui_pending_questions,{0}}]))
  850:     after
  851:         _ = catch ReceiverCall(stop),
  852:         case Saved of undefined -> peer:call(Owner,application,unset_env,[quod,node_actor_principal]);
  853:             {ok,Previous} -> peer:call(Owner,application,set_env,[quod,node_actor_principal,Previous]) end
  854:     end.

  856: %% peer uses standard_io with a nondistributed CT parent. Keep socket delivery
  857: %% and its processing barriers inside the receiver VM; RPC carries assertions.
  858: gui_receiver_start(Ctx,Ns,Anchor) ->
  859:     Session = quod_gui_question_tests:gui_session(Ctx),
  860:     spawn(fun() ->
  861:         Parent = self(),
  862:         {Hud,M} = spawn_monitor(fun() -> quod_gui_question_tests:gui_socket(Parent,#{peer => {127,0,0,1}},true) end),
  863:         Message = fun() -> quod_gui_question_tests:gui_open_message(Ctx,Session,gui_hud,Ns,Anchor,none,0) end,
  864:         gui_receiver_loop(Hud,M,Message)
  865:     end).
  866: 
  867: gui_receiver_loop(Hud,M,Message) ->
  868:     receive
  869:         {'$gen_call',From,renew} ->
  870:             Hud ! {client,Message()},
  871:             Projection = gui_receiver_projection(Hud),
  872:             gen_server:reply(From,Projection),gui_receiver_loop(Hud,M,Message);
  873:         {'$gen_call',From,activated} ->
  874:             receive {gui_view,Hud,#{<<"type">> := <<"gui_prepare">>}} -> ok
  875:             after 10000 -> error(remote_gui_prepare_missing) end,
  876:             receive {gui_view,Hud,#{<<"type">> := <<"gui_activate">>}} -> ok
  877:             after 10000 -> error(remote_gui_activation_missing) end,
  878:             gen_server:reply(From,ok),gui_receiver_loop(Hud,M,Message);
  879:         {'$gen_call',From,stop} ->
  880:             Hud ! stop,
  881:             receive {'DOWN',M,process,Hud,normal} -> gen_server:reply(From,ok)
  882:             after 5000 -> error(remote_gui_not_closed) end;
  883:         {'DOWN',M,process,Hud,Reason} -> error({remote_gui_socket_down,Reason})
  884:     end.
  885: 
  886: gui_receiver_projection(Hud) ->
  887:     receive
  888:         {gui_view,Hud,#{<<"type">> := <<"projection">>} = Projection} -> Projection;
  889:         {gui_view,Hud,#{<<"type">> := <<"refresh">>}} -> gui_receiver_projection(Hud);
  890:         {gui_view,Hud,Other} -> error({remote_gui_projection_failed,Other})
  891:     after 15000 -> error(remote_gui_projection_missing) end.

  893: gui_host_actor(Ctx,Actor = {agent_instance_ref,Ns,_,Instance},Node,Key) ->
  894:     true = quod_reg:subscribe({agent_hosting,Ns}),
  895:     try
  896:         ?assertMatch({ok,_,{normalized,{committed,_,_}}},quod_lobby_tests:submit(Ctx,execute,
  897:             {'::',Ns,{goal,{agent_hosted,Instance,Node,1,Key}}})),
  898:         receive {agent_installed,_,_,#{reference := Actor},_} -> ok
  899:         after 10000 -> error(remote_gui_actor_not_installed) end
  900:     after quod_reg:unsubscribe({agent_hosting,Ns}) end.

  902: gui_complete_answer(Ctx,Actor,Q,Goal) ->
  903:     true = quod_reg:subscribe({agent,Actor}),
  904:     try
  905:         ?assertMatch({ok,_,{normalized,{committed,_,_}}},quod_lobby_tests:submit(Ctx,execute,Goal)),
  906:         receive {agent_request_finished,_,_,#{reference := Actor},_,Result} ->
  907:             {ok,#{request_bytes := Bytes},{normalized,{committed,_,_}}} = Result,
  908:             {ok,#{goal_text := Text}} = quod_client_goal:decode(Bytes),
  909:             {ok,Expected} = quod_client_goal_parser:format({gui_complete,Q}),
  910:             ?assertEqual(quod_client_goal_parser:parse(Expected,3),quod_client_goal_parser:parse(Text,3)),ok
  911:         after 10000 -> error(remote_gui_completion_missing) end
  912:     after quod_reg:unsubscribe({agent,Actor}) end.

  914: %% The same live observer now lies in its next signed directory generation and
  915: %% labels itself a validator. Its key sorts before the real validator, so a
  916: %% role-trusting selector would open the scope there. The certified target
  917: %% committee removes it and resolution reaches the honest coexisting route.
  918: remote_plain_read_rejects_lying_validator(Config) ->
  919:     Asker = ?config(asker, Config),
  920:     Target = ?config(target, Config),
  921:     Liar = ?config(third, Config),
  922:     LiarKey = ?config(third_pub, Config),
  923:     LiarEndpoint = ?config(third_addr, Config),
  924:     TargetKey = ?config(target_pub, Config),
  925:     TargetAnchor = ?config(target_anchor, Config),
  926:     ThirdAnchor = ?config(third_anchor, Config),
  927:     LyingRows = [{?THIRD_NS, ThirdAnchor, validator},
  928:                  {?NS, TargetAnchor, validator}],
  929:     HonestRows = [{?THIRD_NS, ThirdAnchor, validator},
  930:                   {?NS, TargetAnchor, observer}],
  931:     {ok, _} = peer:call(
  932:                 Asker, quod_ct, install_directory_generation,
  933:                 [LiarKey, LiarEndpoint, LyingRows, 1, 2]),
  934:     try
  935:         {known, Routes} = peer:call(
  936:                             Asker, quod_directory, resolve, [?NS]),
  937:         ValidatorKeys = [Key || #{role := validator, node_key := Key} <- Routes],
  938:         ?assertEqual([LiarKey, TargetKey], ValidatorKeys),
  939:         assert_symbol_opaque(Asker, ?config(filter_symbol_name, Config)),
  940:         AtomsBefore = peer:call(Asker, erlang, system_info, [atom_count]),
  941:         assert_remote_scope_owner(Asker, Target, Liar),
  942:         ?assertEqual(
  943:            AtomsBefore, peer:call(Asker, erlang, system_info, [atom_count])),
  944:         assert_symbol_opaque(Asker, ?config(filter_symbol_name, Config))
  945:     after
  946:         {ok, _} = peer:call(
  947:                     Asker, quod_ct, install_directory_generation,
  948:                     [LiarKey, LiarEndpoint, HonestRows, 1, 3])
  949:     end.
  950: 
  951: assert_remote_scope_owner(Asker, Validator, RefusedHost) ->
  952:     wait_scope_workers(Validator, 0, 200),
  953:     wait_scope_workers(RefusedHost, 0, 200),
  954:     Loop = {'::', ?NS, loop},
  955:     Caller = peer:call(Asker, erlang, spawn,
  956:                        [quod_prolog, prove_ro, [?ASKER_NS, Loop]]),
  957:     try
  958:         wait_scope_workers(Validator, 1, 1500),
  959:         ?assertEqual(0, scope_worker_count(RefusedHost))
  960:     after
  961:         true = peer:call(Asker, erlang, exit, [Caller, kill]),
  962:         wait_engine_stat(Asker, ?ASKER_NS, proof_workers, 0, 500),
  963:         wait_scope_workers(Validator, 0, 500),
  964:         wait_scope_workers(RefusedHost, 0, 200)
  965:     end.
  966: 
  967: scope_worker_count(Peer) ->
  968:     maps:get(scope_workers,
  969:              peer:call(Peer, quod_prolog, stats, [?NS]), undefined).
  970: 
  971: assert_symbol_opaque(Peer, SymbolName) ->
  972:     ?assertEqual(
  973:        {ok, {'$quod_symbol', SymbolName}},
  974:        peer:call(Peer, quod_wire_term, decode, [{0, SymbolName}])).
  975: 
  976: remote_scope_solutions(Config) ->
  977:     Asker = ?config(asker, Config),
  978:     Goal = {'::', ?NS, {diet, dog, {'D'}}},
  979:     ?assertMatch({ok, [#{'D' := {'$quod_symbol', <<"kibble">>}}], _},
  980:                  peer:call(Asker, quod_prolog, prove, [?ASKER_NS, Goal], 60000)),
  981:     All = {findall, {'D'}, Goal, {'L'}},
  982:     ?assertMatch({ok, [#{'L' := [{'$quod_symbol', <<"kibble">>},
  983:                                   {'$quod_symbol', <<"meat">>}]}], _},
  984:                  peer:call(Asker, quod_prolog, prove, [?ASKER_NS, All], 60000)).
  985: 
  986: remote_scope_trace_parentage(Config) ->
  987:     Target = ?config(target, Config),
  988:     Asker = ?config(asker, Config),
  989:     %% These peers use standard_io, not Erlang distribution to the CT VM.
  990:     %% All trace collection and monitoring stay on the owning peer; neither
  991:     %% target loads this suite's intentionally caller-only vocabulary.
  992:     Collector = peer:call(Target, quod_trace_fixture, start, []),
  993:     try
  994:         {Result, Public, Open, Directory, ScopeOpen, Request} = peer:call(
  995:                                                                  Asker,
  996:                                                                  quod_trace_fixture,
  997:                                                                  prove,
  998:                                                                  [?ASKER_NS,
  999:                                                                   {'::', ?NS,
 1000:                                                                    {diet, dog,
 1001:                                                                     {'D'}}}],
 1002:                                                                  60000),
 1003:         ?assertMatch({ok, [#{'D' := {'$quod_symbol', <<"kibble">>}}], _}, Result),
 1004:         ?assertEqual(Public#span.trace_id, Open#span.trace_id),
 1005:         ?assertEqual(Open#span.span_id, Directory#span.parent_span_id),
 1006:         ?assertEqual(Directory#span.span_id, ScopeOpen#span.parent_span_id),
 1007:         ?assertEqual(Open#span.span_id, Request#span.parent_span_id),
 1008:         Auth = peer:call(Target, quod_trace_fixture, take_span,
 1009:                          [Collector, <<"quod.scope.authenticate">>, Public#span.trace_id]),
 1010:         InvokeOpen = peer:call(Target, quod_trace_fixture, take_span,
 1011:                               [Collector, <<"quod.scope.invoke_open">>, Public#span.trace_id]),
 1012:         InvokeNext = peer:call(Target, quod_trace_fixture, take_span,
 1013:                               [Collector, <<"quod.scope.invoke_next">>, Public#span.trace_id]),
 1014:         %% These spans are emitted by the actual remote authentication worker
 1015:         %% and target invocation worker, not by a codec-only fixture.
 1016:         lists:foreach(fun(Span) ->
 1017:             ?assertEqual(Public#span.trace_id, Span#span.trace_id),
 1018:             ?assertEqual(ScopeOpen#span.span_id, Span#span.parent_span_id),
 1019:             ?assert(Span#span.parent_span_is_remote),
 1020:             ?assert(Span#span.end_time >= Span#span.start_time)
 1021:         end, [Auth, InvokeOpen, InvokeNext])
 1022:     after
 1023:         ok = peer:call(Target, quod_trace_fixture, stop, [Collector])
 1024:     end.
 1025: 
 1026: remote_scope_symbol_safety(Config) ->
 1027:     Target = ?config(target, Config),
 1028:     Asker = ?config(asker, Config),
 1029:     Echo = {'::', ?NS, {echo, asker_only_symbol}},
 1030:     ?assertMatch({ok, [#{}], _},
 1031:                  peer:call(Asker, quod_prolog, prove,
 1032:                            [?ASKER_NS, Echo], 60000)),
 1033:     ?assertEqual({ok, {'$quod_symbol', <<"asker_only_symbol">>}},
 1034:                  peer:call(Target, quod_wire_term, decode,
 1035:                            [{0, <<"asker_only_symbol">>}])),
 1036:     Unknown = {'::', ?NS, {asker_only_predicate, x}},
 1037:     ?assertMatch({fail, [_ | _]},
 1038:                  peer:call(Asker, quod_prolog, prove,
 1039:                            [?ASKER_NS, Unknown], 60000)).
 1040: 
 1041: %% A retains the new predicate as an opaque symbol. C alone starts with its
 1042: %% fact. B materializes the spelling from a deliberately failing local branch
 1043: %% while leaving C's nested goal opaque, then C returns that same symbol. Both
 1044: %% simultaneous first-use requests must bind without a failed seed request.
 1045: remote_signed_fresh_nested_symbol(Config) ->
 1046:     Asker = ?config(asker, Config),
 1047:     Third = ?config(third, Config),
 1048:     NetworkId = ?config(network_id, Config),
 1049:     AgentPub = ?config(agent_pub, Config),
 1050:     AgentKey = ?config(agent_key, Config),
 1051:     Session = ?config(client_session, Config),
 1052:     ClientPeer = ?config(client_peer, Config),
 1053:     AgentAnchor = ?config(asker_anchor, Config),
 1054:     RaceSuffix = integer_to_list(erlang:unique_integer([positive])),
 1055:     RacePredicateText = "quod_fresh_race_" ++ RaceSuffix,
 1056:     RacePredicate = list_to_atom(RacePredicateText),
 1057:     ?assertMatch(
 1058:        {ok, [_], _},
 1059:        peer:call(
 1060:          Third, quod_prolog, prove,
 1061:          [?THIRD_NS, {assertz, {RacePredicate, ok}}], 60000)),
 1062:     RaceGoalText = iolist_to_binary(
 1063:                      ["\"animals\"::((", RacePredicateText,
 1064:                       "(ok), fail); \"third\"::", RacePredicateText,
 1065:                       "(ok))."]),
 1066:     Requests =
 1067:         [signed_goal_request(
 1068:            NetworkId, AgentPub, AgentKey, ?ASKER_NS, AgentAnchor,
 1069:            maps:get(expires_ms, Session), read, RaceGoalText)
 1070:          || _ <- [first, second]],
 1071:     Parent = self(),
 1072:     RaceRef = make_ref(),
 1073:     Workers =
 1074:         [spawn(
 1075:            fun() ->
 1076:                receive {RaceRef, go} -> ok end,
 1077:                Parent !
 1078:                    {RaceRef, Label,
 1079:                     peer:call(
 1080:                       Asker, quod_client_goal_ingress, submit,
 1081:                       [read, maps:get(session_id, Session), Bytes,
 1082:                        RequestSignature, ClientPeer], 60000)}
 1083:            end)
 1084:          || {Label, {Bytes, RequestSignature}} <-
 1085:                 lists:zip([first, second], Requests)],
 1086:     lists:foreach(fun(Worker) -> Worker ! {RaceRef, go} end, Workers),
 1087:     Results = collect_gateway_race(RaceRef, 2, []),
 1088:     lists:foreach(
 1089:       fun({_Label,
 1090:            {ok, _, {normalized, {read, _, {answers, _Height, [_Answer]}}}}}) -> ok;
 1091:          ({Label, Other}) -> error({fresh_symbol_race_failed, Label, Other})
 1092:       end, Results).
 1093: 
 1094: remote_scope_chain_policy(Config) ->
 1095:     Asker = ?config(asker, Config),
 1096:     Allowed = {'::', ?PRIVATE_NS, {secret, {'X'}}},
 1097:     ?assertMatch(
 1098:        {ok, [#{'X' := 42}], _},
 1099:        peer:call(Asker, quod_prolog, prove,
 1100:                  [?ASKER_NS, Allowed], 60000)),
 1101:     %% A refusal crosses QUIC as ordinary logical failure carrying its bounded
 1102:     %% reason, so the caller can inspect it and branch — same contract as the
 1103:     %% co-hosted path.
 1104:     Denied = {'::', ?PRIVATE_NS, {hidden, {'X'}}},
 1105:     {fail, DeniedReasons} =
 1106:         peer:call(Asker, quod_prolog, prove,
 1107:                   [?ASKER_NS, Denied], 60000),
 1108:     ?assert(lists:member({not_allowed, ?PRIVATE_NS}, DeniedReasons)),
 1109:     ?assertMatch(
 1110:        {ok, [#{'X' := 42}], _},
 1111:        peer:call(Asker, quod_prolog, prove,
 1112:                  [?ASKER_NS, {';', Denied, Allowed}], 60000)),
 1113:     {known, Routes} = peer:call(
 1114:                         Asker, quod_directory, resolve, [?PRIVATE_NS]),
 1115:     ?assert(Routes =/= []),
 1116:     ?assert(lists:all(
 1117:               fun(#{scope := private, status := confirmed}) -> true;
 1118:                  (_) -> false
 1119:               end, Routes)),
 1120:     ?assertEqual([], peer:call(
 1121:                        Asker, quod_directory, directory_hosts,
 1122:                        [?PRIVATE_NS])).

 1124: remote_scope_failure_reasons(Config) ->
 1125:     Asker = ?config(asker, Config),
 1126:     Remote = {'::', ?NS, {blocked, bob}},
 1127:     Recover = {';', Remote,
 1128:                {get_fail_reasons,
 1129:                 [{'Outer'}, {blocked, bob}, {impossible_to_link, bob}]}},
 1130:     ?assertMatch(
 1131:        {ok, [#{'Outer' := Remote}], _},
 1132:        peer:call(Asker, quod_prolog, prove,
 1133:                  [?ASKER_NS, Recover], 60000)).
 1134: 
 1135: %% The C predicate name is compiled only on B/C. A relays it without allocating
 1136: %% an atom; C materializes it after authenticating the scoped command. A's
 1137: %% declared recovery rule then matches C's reason after it returns through B.
 1138: remote_scope_nested_failure_reasons(Config) ->
 1139:     Asker = ?config(asker, Config),
 1140:     ?assertMatch(
 1141:        {ok, [#{}], _},
 1142:        peer:call(Asker, quod_prolog, prove,
 1143:                  [?ASKER_NS, recover_third_failure], 60000)),
 1144:     ?assertEqual(
 1145:        {ok, {'$quod_symbol', <<"third_blocked">>}},
 1146:        peer:call(Asker, quod_wire_term, decode,
 1147:                  [{0, <<"third_blocked">>}])),
 1148:     assert_foreign_current_keeps_symbol_opaque(
 1149:       Asker, ?config(third, Config), ?THIRD_NS,
 1150:       ?config(third_pub, Config), ?config(third_addr, Config),
 1151:       <<"third_blocked">>).
 1152: 
 1153: remote_scope_deep_failure_reasons(Config) ->
 1154:     Asker = ?config(asker, Config),
 1155:     Remote = {'::', ?NS, {deep_failure, 70}},
 1156:     {fail, Reasons} = peer:call(
 1157:                         Asker, quod_prolog, prove,
 1158:                         [?ASKER_NS, Remote], 60000),
 1159:     ?assert(length(Reasons) > 64),
 1160:     ?assertEqual(Remote, hd(Reasons)),
 1161:     ?assertEqual({'$quod_symbol', <<"deep_bottom">>}, lists:last(Reasons)),
 1162:     assert_foreign_current_keeps_symbol_opaque(
 1163:       Asker, ?config(target, Config), ?NS,
 1164:       ?config(target_pub, Config), ?config(target_addr, Config),
 1165:       <<"deep_bottom">>).
 1166: 
 1167: assert_foreign_current_keeps_symbol_opaque(
 1168:   Asker, Host, Ns, HostKey, Endpoint, SymbolName) ->
 1169:     Anchor = peer:call(Host, quod_simplex, genesis_hash, [Ns]),
 1170:     ?assertMatch(
 1171:        {ok, #{identity := {Ns, Anchor}}},
 1172:        peer:call(
 1173:          Asker, quod_foreign_log, current,
 1174:          [[{HostKey, [Endpoint]}], {Ns, Anchor}, 20000], 25000)),
 1175:     %% current/3 must be able to certify and retain the complete foreign
 1176:     %% history without interning that ontology's application vocabulary.
 1177:     ?assertEqual(
 1178:        {ok, {'$quod_symbol', SymbolName}},
 1179:        peer:call(Asker, quod_wire_term, decode, [{0, SymbolName}])).

 1181: remote_scope_structural_reason_truncation(Config) ->
 1182:     Asker = ?config(asker, Config),
 1183:     %% A deep value at the wire boundary must survive intact.  This makes the
 1184:     %% over-depth assertion below non-vacuous: the recursive builder really is
 1185:     %% compiled and its binding crosses the remote proof boundary.
 1186:     Legal = {'::', ?NS, bounded_reason},
 1187:     {fail, LegalReasons} = peer:call(
 1188:                              Asker, quod_prolog, prove,
 1189:                              [?ASKER_NS, Legal], 60000),
 1190:     {ok, Bottom} = peer:call(
 1191:                      Asker, quod_wire_term, decode,
 1192:                      [{0, <<"deep_bottom">>}]),
 1193:     LegalReason = lists:foldl(
 1194:                     fun(_, Acc) -> [Acc] end, Bottom,
 1195:                     lists:seq(1, 63)),
 1196:     ?assert(lists:member(LegalReason, LegalReasons)),
 1197:     ?assert(quod_wire_term:valid_failure_reason_stack(LegalReasons)),
 1198: 
 1199:     Remote = {'::', ?NS, deep_reason},
 1200:     {fail, Reasons} = peer:call(
 1201:                         Asker, quod_prolog, prove,
 1202:                         [?ASKER_NS, Remote], 60000),
 1203:     ?assertEqual(Remote, hd(Reasons)),
 1204:     ?assert(lists:member(deep_reason, Reasons)),
 1205:     ?assert(lists:member(fail_reasons_truncated, Reasons)),
 1206:     ?assert(quod_wire_term:valid_failure_reason_stack(Reasons)).

 1208: remote_scope_cancel(Config) ->
 1209:     Target = ?config(target, Config),
 1210:     Asker = ?config(asker, Config),
 1211:     Loop = {'::', ?NS, loop},
 1212:     Caller = peer:call(Asker, erlang, spawn,
 1213:                        [quod_prolog, prove, [?ASKER_NS, Loop]]),
 1214:     wait_scope_workers(Target, 1, 200),
 1215:     true = peer:call(Asker, erlang, exit, [Caller, kill]),
 1216:     wait_scope_workers(Target, 0, 200).

 1218: %% Scope commands share the bounded node-level router without sharing proof
 1219: %% state. Two full waves prove that completed scopes release every target worker
 1220: %% and leave the transport reusable for independent proofs.
 1221: remote_scope_transport_reuse(Config) ->
 1222:     Target = ?config(target, Config),
 1223:     Asker = ?config(asker, Config),
 1224:     Goal = {'::', ?NS, {diet, dog, kibble}},
 1225:     run_scope_wave(Asker, Goal, first),
 1226:     wait_scope_workers(Target, 0, 200),
 1227:     run_scope_wave(Asker, Goal, second),
 1228:     wait_scope_workers(Target, 0, 200).

 1230: %% The browser is logged into A as an agent stored in A. Exact selectors reach
 1231: %% B through the ordinary scope path. A has no ACL clause for these goals, so
 1232: %% success proves that A authenticates identity while B alone authorizes B's
 1233: %% predicate.
 1234: remote_signed_gateway_read_execute_cursor(Config) ->
 1235:     Asker = ?config(asker, Config),
 1236:     Target = ?config(target, Config),
 1237:     NetworkId = ?config(network_id, Config),
 1238:     AgentKey = ?config(agent_key, Config),
 1239:     AgentPub = ?config(agent_pub, Config),
 1240:     Session = ?config(client_session, Config),
 1241:     Peer = ?config(client_peer, Config),
 1242:     AgentAnchor = ?config(asker_anchor, Config),
 1243: 
 1244:     {ReadBytes, ReadSignature} = signed_goal_request(
 1245:                                    NetworkId, AgentPub, AgentKey,
 1246:                                    ?ASKER_NS, AgentAnchor,
 1247:                                    maps:get(expires_ms, Session), read,
 1248:                                    <<"\"animals\"::diet(dog, D).">>),
 1249:     {ok, ReadEvidence,
 1250:      {normalized, {read, ReadDependencies, {answers, ReadHeight, ReadBlobs}}}} =
 1251:         peer:call(
 1252:           Asker, quod_client_goal_ingress, submit,
 1253:           [read, maps:get(session_id, Session), ReadBytes, ReadSignature, Peer],
 1254:           60000),
 1255:     ?assertEqual({?ASKER_NS,AgentAnchor,ReadHeight},
 1256:         lists:keyfind(?ASKER_NS,1,ReadDependencies)),
 1257:     ?assertEqual({?NS,?config(target_anchor,Config),
 1258:                   peer:call(?config(target,Config),quod_prolog,applied,[?NS])},
 1259:         lists:keyfind(?NS,1,ReadDependencies)),
 1260:     ?assertEqual(ReadBytes, maps:get(request_bytes, ReadEvidence)),
 1261:     ?assertEqual(ReadSignature, maps:get(signature, ReadEvidence)),
 1262:     ?assertEqual(
 1263:        [[{<<"D">>, kibble}]],
 1264:        [begin {ok, Binding} = quod_durable_term:decode_result(Blob), Binding end
 1265:         || Blob <- ReadBlobs]),
 1266:     Tag = erlang:unique_integer([positive]),
 1267:     ExecuteText = iolist_to_binary(
 1268:                     io_lib:format("assertz(gateway_mark(~B)).", [Tag])),
 1269:     {ExecuteBytes, ExecuteSignature} = signed_goal_request(
 1270:                                          NetworkId, AgentPub, AgentKey,
 1271:                                          ?ASKER_NS, AgentAnchor,
 1272:                                          maps:get(expires_ms, Session),
 1273:                                          execute,
 1274:                                          <<"\"animals\"::", ExecuteText/binary>>),
 1275:     {ok, ExecuteEvidence,
 1276:      {normalized,
 1277:       {committed, [_],
 1278:        {transaction, ?NS, TargetAnchor, _} = ExecuteTargetRef}}} =
 1279:         peer:call(
 1280:           Asker, quod_client_goal_ingress, submit,
 1281:           [execute, maps:get(session_id, Session), ExecuteBytes,
 1282:            ExecuteSignature, Peer], 60000),
 1283:     ?assertEqual(
 1284:        ExecuteTargetRef,
 1285:        completed_remote_operation(
 1286:          Asker, maps:get(operation_ref, ExecuteEvidence), 600)),
 1287:     assert_fact_once(Target, ?NS, gateway_mark, Tag),
 1288: 
 1289:     CursorText =
 1290:         <<"\"animals\"::(diet(dog, D), assertz(gateway_choice(D))).">>,
 1291:     {CursorBytes, CursorSignature} = signed_goal_request(
 1292:                                        NetworkId, AgentPub, AgentKey,
 1293:                                        ?ASKER_NS, AgentAnchor,
 1294:                                        maps:get(expires_ms, Session),
 1295:                                        cursor, CursorText),
 1296:     {ok, CursorEvidence,
 1297:      {normalized, {solution, CursorId, _, FirstBlob}}} =
 1298:         peer:call(
 1299:           Asker, quod_client_goal_ingress, submit,
 1300:           [cursor, maps:get(session_id, Session), CursorBytes,
 1301:            CursorSignature, Peer], 60000),
 1302:     ?assertEqual({ok, [{<<"D">>, kibble}]},
 1303:                  quod_durable_term:decode_result(FirstBlob)),
 1304:     {ok, CursorEvidence,
 1305:      {normalized, {solution, CursorId, _, SecondBlob}}} =
 1306:         peer:call(
 1307:           Asker, quod_client_goal_ingress, cursor_command,
 1308:           [maps:get(session_id, Session), CursorId, next, Peer], 60000),
 1309:     ?assertEqual({ok, [{<<"D">>, meat}]},
 1310:                  quod_durable_term:decode_result(SecondBlob)),
 1311:     {ok, CursorEvidence,
 1312:      {normalized,
 1313:       {committed, [_],
 1314:        {transaction, ?NS, TargetAnchor, _} = CursorTargetRef}}} =
 1315:         peer:call(
 1316:           Asker, quod_client_goal_ingress, cursor_command,
 1317:           [maps:get(session_id, Session), CursorId, accept, Peer], 60000),
 1318:     ?assertEqual(
 1319:        CursorTargetRef,
 1320:        completed_remote_operation(
 1321:          Asker, maps:get(operation_ref, CursorEvidence), 600)),
 1322:     assert_fact_once(Target, ?NS, gateway_choice, meat),
 1323: 
 1324:     {StopBytes, StopSignature} = signed_goal_request(
 1325:                                    NetworkId, AgentPub, AgentKey,
 1326:                                    ?ASKER_NS, AgentAnchor,
 1327:                                    maps:get(expires_ms, Session), cursor,
 1328:                                    <<"\"animals\"::diet(dog, D).">>),
 1329:     {ok, _, {normalized, {solution, StopCursor, _, _}}} =
 1330:         peer:call(
 1331:           Asker, quod_client_goal_ingress, submit,
 1332:           [cursor, maps:get(session_id, Session), StopBytes,
 1333:            StopSignature, Peer], 60000),
 1334:     ?assertMatch(
 1335:        {ok, _, {normalized, stopped}},
 1336:        peer:call(
 1337:          Asker, quod_client_goal_ingress, cursor_command,
 1338:          [maps:get(session_id, Session), StopCursor, stop, Peer], 60000)).
