 1340: %% B contributes only a certified read. C remains the sole writer, so this is
 1341: %% one ordinary remote operation claim and target transaction, never a DTX
 1342: %% group with an empty source Vote/Resolve role for B.
 1343: remote_signed_read_certified_write(Config) ->
 1344:     Asker = ?config(asker, Config),
 1345:     Third = ?config(third, Config),
 1346:     Tag = erlang:unique_integer([positive]),
 1347:     GoalText = iolist_to_binary(
 1348:                  io_lib:format(
 1349:                    "\"animals\"::diet(dog, kibble), "
 1350:                    "\"third\"::dtx_write(~B).", [Tag])),
 1351:     {ok, Evidence,
 1352:      {normalized,
 1353:       {committed, [_],
 1354:        {transaction, ?THIRD_NS, ThirdAnchor, _} = TargetRef}}} =
 1355:         submit_signed_execute(Config, GoalText),
 1356:     ?assertEqual(
 1357:        ThirdAnchor,
 1358:        peer:call(Third, quod_simplex, genesis_hash, [?THIRD_NS])),
 1359:     ?assertEqual(
 1360:        TargetRef,
 1361:        completed_remote_operation(
 1362:          Asker, maps:get(operation_ref, Evidence), 600)),
 1363:     assert_fact_once(Third, ?THIRD_NS, dtx_third_mark, Tag).
 1364: 
 1365: %% R4-UNCERTAIN-CLAIM-DELIVERY-01: this is a real signed operation admitted
 1366: %% through the ordinary client, source consensus, and remote target. Once it
 1367: %% is accepted, deliver the SAME durable claim twice more through the real
 1368: %% endpoint. Only the transport correlation id changes. No hand-built claim,
 1369: %% new signed goal, new application identity, or admission bypass is used.
 1370: remote_exact_claim_redelivery(Config) ->
 1371:     Asker = ?config(asker, Config),
 1372:     Third = ?config(third, Config),
 1373:     Tag = erlang:unique_integer([positive]),
 1374:     Goal = iolist_to_binary(io_lib:format(
 1375:              "\"animals\"::diet(dog, kibble), \"third\"::dtx_write(~B).", [Tag])),
 1376:     {ok, Evidence, {normalized, {committed, [_],
 1377:         {transaction, ?THIRD_NS, Anchor, TxId} = TargetRef}}} =
 1378:         submit_signed_execute(Config, Goal),
 1379:     OperationRef = maps:get(operation_ref, Evidence),
 1380:     ?assertEqual(TargetRef, completed_remote_operation(Asker, OperationRef, 600)),
 1381:     {ok, #{height := ClaimSlot}} = peer:call(
 1382:         Asker, quod_prolog, local_outcome, [?ASKER_NS, OperationRef]),
 1383:     Deadline = peer:call(Asker, quod_time, mono_ms, []) + 5000,
 1384:     {ok, CertifiedClaimRef, Claim} = peer:call(
 1385:         Asker, quod_simplex, operation_claim_evidence,
 1386:         [?ASKER_NS, ClaimSlot, OperationRef, Deadline]),
 1387:     {ok, ClaimBytes} = quod_transaction:encode_evidence(CertifiedClaimRef, Claim),
 1388:     Target = {?THIRD_NS, Anchor},
 1389:     StableClaimRef = quod_transaction:stable_ref(CertifiedClaimRef),
 1390:     ?assertMatch(#transaction{tx_id = TxId},
 1391:         quod_transaction:remote_application(StableClaimRef, Claim, Target)),
 1392:     Before = peer:call(Third, ?MODULE, claim_application_occurrences,
 1393:                        [?THIRD_NS, TxId]),
 1394:     ?assertMatch([_], Before),
 1395:     lists:foreach(fun(_) ->
 1396:         ?assertEqual({ok, ClaimBytes},
 1397:                      quod_transaction:encode_evidence(CertifiedClaimRef, Claim)),
 1398:         RequestId = crypto:strong_rand_bytes(16),
 1399:         Request = {apply_claim, RequestId, Target, ClaimBytes},
 1400:         {ok, {application, RequestId, committed, ApplicationBytes} = Response,
 1401:          _Hints} =
 1402:             peer:call(Asker, quod_dtx_current_view, submit_claim_application,
 1403:                       [?ASKER_NS, Target, Claim, Request, 5000], 10000),
 1404:         ?assert(quod_dtx_endpoint:correlates(Request, Response)),
 1405:         {ok, ApplicationRef, #transaction{tx_id = TxId,
 1406:             role = {remote_application, _, _, _}}} =
 1407:             quod_transaction:decode_evidence(ApplicationBytes),
 1408:         ?assertEqual(TargetRef, quod_transaction:stable_ref(ApplicationRef)),
 1409:         ?assertEqual(Before, peer:call(Third, ?MODULE,
 1410:             claim_application_occurrences, [?THIRD_NS, TxId])),
 1411:         assert_fact_once(Third, ?THIRD_NS, dtx_third_mark, Tag)
 1412:     end, [first_redelivery, second_redelivery]).
 1413: 
 1414: %% Test-side audit only, executed ON the target. An ordinary immutable owner
 1415: %% snapshot is read without returning any store or interpreter state to the
 1416: %% caller. Count ledger occurrences as well as visible facts: an extra inert
 1417: %% or rejected envelope must not hide a second application under the same id.
 1418: claim_application_occurrences(Ns, TxId) ->
 1419:     {ok, #{snapshot := Snapshot, slot := Height}} =
 1420:         quod_simplex:history_view(Ns, any, quod_time:mono_ms() + 5000),
 1421:     {ok, Store} = quod_ledger_store:open_ro_snapshot(Snapshot),
 1422:     try
 1423:         lists:reverse(quod_ledger_store:fold(Store, 1, Height,
 1424:             fun(Entry, Acc) ->
 1425:                 case quod_ledger:entry_view(Entry) of
 1426:                     #entry{index = Slot, data = {batch, Transactions}} ->
 1427:                         [Slot || #transaction{tx_id = Id,
 1428:                             role = {remote_application, _, _, _}} <- Transactions,
 1429:                             Id =:= TxId] ++ Acc;
 1430:                     _ -> Acc
 1431:                 end
 1432:             end, []))
 1433:     after quod_ledger_store:close(Store)
 1434:     end.
 1435: 
 1436: %% A writes locally while B contributes only a certified read. The result is
 1437: %% A's ordinary transaction; there is no source claim and no DTX group.
 1438: local_write_with_foreign_read(Config) ->
 1439:     Asker = ?config(asker, Config),
 1440:     Tag = erlang:unique_integer([positive]),
 1441:     GoalText = iolist_to_binary(
 1442:                  io_lib:format(
 1443:                    "assertz(signed_pets_mark(~B)), "
 1444:                    "\"animals\"::diet(dog, kibble).", [Tag])),
 1445:     ?assertMatch(
 1446:        {ok, _,
 1447:         {normalized,
 1448:          {committed, [_], {transaction, ?ASKER_NS, _, _}}}},
 1449:        submit_signed_execute(Config, GoalText)),
 1450:     assert_fact_once(Asker, ?ASKER_NS, signed_pets_mark, Tag).
 1451: 
 1452: %% The read token is sealed first. B then commits another diet/2 fact before
 1453: %% its validators sign the certificate. Certification must reject the stale
 1454: %% token and A's local write must remain absent.
 1455: read_certificate_stale_rejected(Config) ->
 1456:     Asker = ?config(asker, Config),
 1457:     Target = ?config(target, Config),
 1458:     Tag = erlang:unique_integer([positive]),
 1459:     GoalText = iolist_to_binary(
 1460:                  io_lib:format(
 1461:                    "assertz(signed_pets_mark(~B)), "
 1462:                    "\"animals\"::diet(dog, kibble).", [Tag])),
 1463:     ok = peer:call(
 1464:            Asker, quod_prolog,
 1465:            test_install_read_certificate_barrier, []),
 1466:     Parent = self(),
 1467:     RequestRef = make_ref(),
 1468:     _ = spawn(
 1469:           fun() ->
 1470:               Parent ! {RequestRef, submit_signed_execute(Config, GoalText)}
 1471:           end),
 1472:     try
 1473:         ok = peer:call(
 1474:                Asker, quod_prolog,
 1475:                test_await_read_certificate_barrier, [3000]),
 1476:         ?assertMatch(
 1477:            {ok, [_], _},
 1478:            peer:call(
 1479:              Target, quod_prolog, prove,
 1480:              [?NS, {assertz, {diet, dog, {stale_marker, Tag}}}],
 1481:              60000))
 1482:     after
 1483:         %% Never leave the TEST-only rendezvous installed if an assertion
 1484:         %% above fails: a later proof would otherwise correctly wait forever.
 1485:         _ = peer:call(
 1486:               Asker, quod_prolog,
 1487:               test_release_read_certificate_barrier, [])
 1488:     end,
 1489:     Result = receive
 1490:                  {RequestRef, Value} -> Value
 1491:              after 60000 ->
 1492:                  ct:fail(stale_read_request_did_not_finish)
 1493:              end,
 1494:     ?assertMatch(
 1495:        {ok, _, {normalized, {error, conflict_retry}}}, Result),
 1496:     assert_fact_absent(Asker, ?ASKER_NS, signed_pets_mark, Tag).
 1497: 
 1498: %% The signed claim lane treats A's own read exactly like any other read-only
 1499: %% dependency. If A changes after sealing but before certification, neither the
 1500: %% source claim nor C's write may be submitted.
 1501: remote_signed_origin_read_certificate_stale_rejected(Config) ->
 1502:     Asker = ?config(asker, Config),
 1503:     Third = ?config(third, Config),
 1504:     Tag = erlang:unique_integer([positive]),
 1505:     GoalText = iolist_to_binary(
 1506:                  io_lib:format(
 1507:                    "instance_of(pet, my_dog), \"third\"::dtx_write(~B).",
 1508:                    [Tag])),
 1509:     ok = peer:call(
 1510:            Asker, quod_prolog,
 1511:            test_install_read_certificate_barrier, []),
 1512:     Parent = self(),
 1513:     RequestRef = make_ref(),
 1514:     _ = spawn(
 1515:           fun() ->
 1516:               Parent ! {RequestRef, submit_signed_execute(Config, GoalText)}
 1517:           end),
 1518:     try
 1519:         ok = peer:call(
 1520:                Asker, quod_prolog,
 1521:                test_await_read_certificate_barrier, [3000]),
 1522:         %% The source proof is deliberately parked before its certificate.
 1523:         %% Commit the intervening source-head change at the consensus seam so
 1524:         %% this test does not depend on a second client ingress being admitted
 1525:         %% while the first signed request still owns that ingress session.
 1526:         append_source_marker(Config, Tag)
 1527:     after
 1528:         _ = peer:call(
 1529:               Asker, quod_prolog,
 1530:               test_release_read_certificate_barrier, [])
 1531:     end,
 1532:     Result = receive
 1533:                  {RequestRef, Value} -> Value
 1534:              after 60000 ->
 1535:                  ct:fail(origin_stale_read_request_did_not_finish)
 1536:              end,
 1537:     ?assertMatch(
 1538:        {ok, _, {normalized, {error, conflict_retry}}}, Result),
 1539:     assert_fact_absent(Third, ?THIRD_NS, dtx_third_mark, Tag).
 1540: 
 1541: %% Two independent gateways race the same signed execute. One may receive a
 1542: %% typed pre-custody availability refusal while the other proof is sealing;
 1543: %% the stable operation claim must still give both gateways one durable result
 1544: %% and one material write.
 1545: remote_signed_two_gateway_race(Config) ->
 1546:     Asker = ?config(asker, Config),
 1547:     Third = ?config(third, Config),
 1548:     Target = ?config(target, Config),
 1549:     NetworkId = ?config(network_id, Config),
 1550:     AgentPub = ?config(agent_pub, Config),
 1551:     AgentKey = ?config(agent_key, Config),
 1552:     ClientPeer = ?config(client_peer, Config),
 1553:     AskerSession = open_client_session(
 1554:                      Asker, NetworkId, ?config(asker_pub, Config),
 1555:                      AgentKey, ClientPeer),
 1556:     ThirdSession = open_client_session(
 1557:                      Third, NetworkId, ?config(third_pub, Config),
 1558:                      AgentKey, ClientPeer),
 1559:     AgentAnchor = ?config(asker_anchor, Config),
 1560:     Tag = erlang:unique_integer([positive]),
 1561:     GoalText = iolist_to_binary(
 1562:                  io_lib:format(
 1563:                    "\"animals\"::assertz(gateway_race_mark(~B)).", [Tag])),
 1564:     Expires = min(maps:get(expires_ms, AskerSession),
 1565:                   maps:get(expires_ms, ThirdSession)),
 1566:     {RequestBytes, Signature} = signed_goal_request(
 1567:                                   NetworkId, AgentPub, AgentKey,
 1568:                                   ?ASKER_NS, AgentAnchor,
 1569:                                   Expires, execute, GoalText),
 1570:     Parent = self(),
 1571:     RaceRef = make_ref(),
 1572:     _ = spawn(
 1573:           fun() ->
 1574:               Parent !
 1575:                 {RaceRef, asker,
 1576:                  peer:call(
 1577:                    Asker, quod_client_goal_ingress, submit,
 1578:                    [execute, maps:get(session_id, AskerSession),
 1579:                     RequestBytes, Signature, ClientPeer], 60000)}
 1580:           end),
 1581:     _ = spawn(
 1582:           fun() ->
 1583:               Parent !
 1584:                 {RaceRef, third,
 1585:                  peer:call(
 1586:                    Third, quod_client_goal_ingress, submit,
 1587:                    [execute, maps:get(session_id, ThirdSession),
 1588:                     RequestBytes, Signature, ClientPeer], 60000)}
 1589:           end),
 1590:     Results = collect_gateway_race(RaceRef, 2, []),
 1591:     Classified = [classify_race_submit(Result)
 1592:                   || {_Gateway, Result} <- Results],
 1593:     Evidences = [Ev || {accepted, Ev} <- Classified],
 1594:     %% A simultaneous second proof may be refused before durable custody while
 1595:     %% the first proof is still sealing. That refusal is safe because both
 1596:     %% gateways retain the exact same signed request and operation reference;
 1597:     %% after the first claim commits, either gateway must resolve it.
 1598:     ?assert(Evidences =/= []),
 1599:     [Evidence | _] = Evidences,
 1600:     OperationRef = maps:get(operation_ref, Evidence),
 1601:     lists:foreach(
 1602:       fun(Ev) ->
 1603:           ?assertEqual(OperationRef, maps:get(operation_ref, Ev)),
 1604:           ?assertEqual(RequestBytes, maps:get(request_bytes, Ev)),
 1605:           ?assertEqual(Signature, maps:get(signature, Ev))
 1606:       end, Evidences),
 1607:     OutcomeRef = {transaction, ?NS, TargetAnchor, _} =
 1608:         completed_remote_operation(Asker, OperationRef, 600),
 1609:     ?assertEqual(
 1610:        TargetAnchor,
 1611:        peer:call(Target, quod_simplex, genesis_hash, [?NS])),
 1612:     ?assertMatch(
 1613:        {ok, #{status := claimed, operation_state := terminal,
 1614:               outcome_ref := {applications, [{transaction, ?NS, TargetAnchor, _}]}}},
 1615:        peer:call(Third, quod_prolog, outcome, [OperationRef])),
 1616:     ?assertMatch(
 1617:        {ok, _, {operation_outcome,
 1618:                 #{status := claimed, outcome_ref := _},
 1619:                 #{status := completed,
 1620:                   targets := [{{?NS, TargetAnchor}, {committed, OutcomeRef}}]}}},
 1621:        wait_remote_operation(
 1622:          Asker, maps:get(session_id, AskerSession), RequestBytes,
 1623:          Signature, ClientPeer, 8)),
 1624:     {ok, #{status := committed, height := OutcomeHeight, ref := OutcomeRef}} =
 1625:         peer:call(Target, quod_prolog, outcome, [OutcomeRef]),
 1626:     %% Third is an observer of the target ontology. A remote result at Asker
 1627:     %% does not mean Third's local projection has consumed the target block.
 1628:     %% Wait for that actual event; do not resubmit, nudge the feed, or replace
 1629:     %% the fixture's ordering requirement with a short repeated resolve loop.
 1630:     ok = peer:call(Third, quod_ct, await_applied,
 1631:                    [?NS, OutcomeHeight, 10000], 15000),
 1632:     ?assertMatch(
 1633:        {ok, _, {operation_outcome,
 1634:                 #{status := claimed, outcome_ref := _},
 1635:                 #{status := completed,
 1636:                   targets := [{{?NS, TargetAnchor}, {committed, OutcomeRef}}]}}},
 1637:        peer:call(
 1638:          Third, quod_client_goal_ingress, resolve_operation,
 1639:          [maps:get(session_id, ThirdSession), RequestBytes,
 1640:           Signature, ClientPeer], 10000)),
 1641:     assert_fact_once(Target, ?NS, gateway_race_mark, Tag).
 1642: 
 1643: %% A signed agent stored in A reaches B and then C through the same nested
 1644: %% scope and group machinery. No specialized client or agent executor exists.
 1645: %% Real signed proofs use the same action evaluator locally at animals, on
 1646: %% its co-hosted fourth namespace, and remotely at third. The first candidate
 1647: %% crosses both boundaries, stages facts/events, cuts and fails. Only the
 1648: %% complete second candidate may reach any target ledger.
 1649: independent_action_multiscope_rollback(Config) ->
 1650:     require_third_route_at_target(Config),
 1651:     Tag = erlang:unique_integer([positive]),
 1652:     Setup = iolist_to_binary(io_lib:format(
 1653:       "animals::(assertz((action_bad(~B) :- "
 1654:       "assertz(action_leak(~B)), trigger_event(action_leak(~B)), "
 1655:       "fourth::(assertz(action_leak(~B)), trigger_event(action_leak(~B))), "
 1656:       "third::(assertz(action_leak(~B)), trigger_event(action_leak(~B))), !, fail)), "
 1657:       "assertz((action_good(~B) :- assertz(action_done(~B)), trigger_event(action_done(~B)), "
 1658:       "fourth::(assertz(action_done(~B)), trigger_event(action_done(~B))), "
 1659:       "third::(assertz(action_done(~B)), trigger_event(action_done(~B))))), "
 1660:       "assertz(action(action_bad(~B), [], action_done(~B))), "
 1661:       "assertz(action(action_good(~B), [], action_done(~B)))).", lists:duplicate(18, Tag))),
 1662:     ?assertMatch({ok, _, {normalized, {committed, [_], _}}}, submit_signed_execute(Config, Setup)),
 1663:     Text = iolist_to_binary(io_lib:format("animals::independent(goal(action_done(~B))).", [Tag])),
 1664:     {ok, _, {normalized, {committed, [_], {operation_outcome, _, Rows}}}} =
 1665:         submit_signed_execute(Config, Text),
 1666:     ?assertEqual(all_applied, quod_operation_vector:aggregate(Rows)),
 1667:     ?assertEqual([?NS, ?FOURTH_NS, ?THIRD_NS], [Ns || {{Ns, _}, _} <- Rows]),
 1668:     Owners = #{?NS => ?config(target, Config), ?FOURTH_NS => ?config(target, Config),
 1669:                ?THIRD_NS => ?config(third, Config)},
 1670:     lists:foreach(fun({{Ns, _}, {committed, {transaction, Ns, _, Id}}}) ->
 1671:         Peer = maps:get(Ns, Owners),
 1672:         assert_fact_once(Peer, Ns, action_done, Tag),
 1673:         assert_fact_absent(Peer, Ns, action_leak, Tag),
 1674:         Changes = peer:call(Peer, ?MODULE, action_application_changes, [Ns, Id]),
 1675:         ?assertEqual([{action_done, Tag}], [E || {event, E} <- Changes])
 1676:     end, Rows).
 1677: 
 1678: independent_action_remote_errors(Config) ->
 1679:     require_third_route_at_target(Config),
 1680:     Tag = erlang:unique_integer([positive]),
 1681:     Setup = iolist_to_binary(io_lib:format(
 1682:       "animals::(assertz((action_error(~B) :- assertz(action_error_leak(~B)), "
 1683:       "third::(assertz(action_error_leak(~B)), assertz(true)))), "
 1684:       "assertz(action(action_error(~B), [], action_error_done(~B)))).", lists:duplicate(5, Tag))),
 1685:     ?assertMatch({ok, _, {normalized, {committed, [_], _}}}, submit_signed_execute(Config, Setup)),
 1686:     Text = iolist_to_binary(io_lib:format("animals::independent(goal(action_error_done(~B))).", [Tag])),
 1687:     Target = ?config(target, Config),
 1688:     Capture = peer:call(Target, ?MODULE, start_action_error_capture, []),
 1689:     {Result, Errors} = try
 1690:         {submit_signed_execute(Config, Text),
 1691:          peer:call(Target, ?MODULE, finish_action_error_capture, [Capture])}
 1692:     catch Class:Reason:Stack ->
 1693:         peer:call(Target, ?MODULE, finish_action_error_capture, [Capture]),
 1694:         erlang:raise(Class, Reason, Stack)
 1695:     end,
 1696:     %% Public normalization deliberately hides language descriptors. Pin the
 1697:     %% original error at the real worker return, then the unchanged public form.
 1698:     ?assert(lists:member({permission_error, modify, static_procedure, {'/', true, 0}}, Errors)),
 1699:     ?assertMatch({ok, _, {normalized, {error, proof_unavailable}}}, Result),
 1700:     lists:foreach(fun({Peer, Ns}) ->
 1701:         assert_fact_absent(Peer, Ns, action_error_leak, Tag)
 1702:     end, [{?config(target, Config), ?NS}, {?config(third, Config), ?THIRD_NS}]).
 1703: 
 1704: start_action_error_capture() ->
 1705:     Pid = spawn(fun() -> action_error_capture([], none) end),
 1706:     1 = erlang:trace_pattern({quod_proof_scope, next, 1}, [{'_', [], [{return_trace}]}], [local]),
 1707:     _ = erlang:trace(all, true, [call, {tracer, Pid}]),
 1708:     Pid.
 1709: 
 1710: finish_action_error_capture(Pid) ->
 1711:     _ = erlang:trace(all, false, [call]),
 1712:     _ = erlang:trace_pattern({quod_proof_scope, next, 1}, false, [local]),
 1713:     Ref = make_ref(), Pid ! {finish, self(), Ref},
 1714:     receive {Ref, Errors} -> Errors after 5000 -> erlang:error(action_trace_timeout) end.
 1715: 
 1716: action_error_capture(Errors, Closing) ->
 1717:     receive
 1718:         {trace, _, return_from, {quod_proof_scope, next, 1},
 1719:          {error, {erlog, Reason}, _, _}} ->
 1720:             true = length(Errors) < 16,
 1721:             action_error_capture([Reason | Errors], Closing);
 1722:         {finish, Caller, Ref} ->
 1723:             Delivery = erlang:trace_delivered(all),
 1724:             action_error_capture(Errors, {Caller, Ref, Delivery});
 1725:         {trace_delivered, all, Delivery} ->
 1726:             {Caller, Ref, Delivery} = Closing, Caller ! {Ref, Errors};
 1727:         _ -> action_error_capture(Errors, Closing)
 1728:     end.
 1729: 
 1730: action_application_changes(Ns, TxId) ->
 1731:     {ok, #{snapshot := Snapshot, slot := Height}} =
 1732:         quod_simplex:history_view(Ns, any, quod_time:mono_ms() + 5000),
 1733:     {ok, Store} = quod_ledger_store:open_ro_snapshot(Snapshot),
 1734:     try
 1735:         [Changes] = quod_ledger_store:fold(Store, 1, Height,
 1736:           fun(Entry, Acc) ->
 1737:               case quod_ledger:entry_view(Entry) of
 1738:                   #entry{data = {batch, Txs}} ->
 1739:                       [Diff || #transaction{tx_id = Id, diff = Diff} <- Txs,
 1740:                                Id =:= TxId] ++ Acc;
 1741:                   _ -> Acc
 1742:               end
 1743:           end, []),
 1744:         Changes
 1745:     after quod_ledger_store:close(Store)
 1746:     end.
 1747: 
 1748: %% Root's governed create_ontology bridge uses the same action evaluator and
 1749: %% its private savepoint. The other target writes ordinary facts; Root remains
 1750: %% effect-only, and exact durable claim redelivery cannot repeat the effect.
 1751: independent_action_remote_prepared_rollback(Config) ->
 1752:     Tag = erlang:unique_integer([positive]),
 1753:     Discarded = iolist_to_binary(["ct:action-discarded-", integer_to_binary(Tag)]),
 1754:     Kept = iolist_to_binary(["ct:action-kept-", integer_to_binary(Tag)]),
 1755:     Setup = iolist_to_binary(io_lib:format(
 1756:       "(assertz(signed_pets_mark(~B)), "
 1757:       "assertz((action_effect_bad(~B) :- \"quod:root\"::create_ontology(\"~s\", [], _), !, fail)), "
 1758:       "assertz((action_effect_good(~B) :- \"quod:root\"::create_ontology(\"~s\", [], _), assertz(action_effect_done(~B)))), "
 1759:       "assertz(action(action_effect_bad(~B), [], action_effect_done(~B))), "
 1760:       "assertz(action(action_effect_good(~B), [], action_effect_done(~B)))).",
 1761:       [Tag, Tag, Discarded, Tag, Kept, Tag, Tag, Tag, Tag, Tag])),
 1762:     ?assertMatch({ok, _, {normalized, {committed, [_], _}}}, submit_signed_execute(Config, Setup)),
 1763:     Text = iolist_to_binary(io_lib:format("independent(goal(action_effect_done(~B))).", [Tag])),
 1764:     {ok, _, {normalized, {committed, [_], {operation_outcome, Op, Rows}}}} =
 1765:         submit_signed_execute(Config, Text),
 1766:     ?assertEqual(all_applied, quod_operation_vector:aggregate(Rows)),
 1767:     ?assertEqual([?ASKER_NS, ?ROOT_NS], [Ns || {{Ns, _}, _} <- Rows]),
 1768:     Target = ?config(target, Config), Asker = ?config(asker, Config),
 1769:     ?assertEqual({ok, not_hosted}, peer:call(Target, quod_ontology, local_state, [Discarded])),
 1770:     ?assertEqual({ok, ready}, peer:call(Target, quod_ontology, local_state, [Kept])),
 1771:     assert_fact_once(Asker, ?ASKER_NS, action_effect_done, Tag),
 1772:     assert_operation_redelivery(Config, Op, Rows, #{?ASKER_NS => Asker, ?ROOT_NS => Target}),
 1773:     ?assertEqual({ok, not_hosted}, peer:call(Target, quod_ontology, local_state, [Discarded])).
 1774: 
 1775: remote_independent_root_effect(Config) ->
 1776:     Asker = ?config(asker, Config), Target = ?config(target, Config),
 1777:     Tag = erlang:unique_integer([positive]),
 1778:     CreatedNs = iolist_to_binary(["ct:s8-effect-", integer_to_binary(Tag)]),
 1779:     Goal = iolist_to_binary(io_lib:format(
 1780:       "independent((assertz(s8_effect_mark(~B)), "
 1781:       "\"quod:root\"::create_ontology(\"~s\", "
 1782:       "[source(\"can_invoke(_, _, _, _).\\n"
 1783:       "s8_effect_created(ok).\\n\")], _Anchor))).", [Tag, CreatedNs])),
 1784:     {ok, Evidence, {normalized, {committed, [_], {operation_outcome, Op, Rows}}}} =
 1785:         submit_signed_execute(Config, Goal),
 1786:     ?assertEqual(maps:get(operation_ref, Evidence), Op),
 1787:     ?assertEqual(all_applied, quod_operation_vector:aggregate(Rows)),
 1788:     ?assertEqual([?ASKER_NS, ?ROOT_NS], [Ns || {{Ns, _}, _} <- Rows]),
 1789:     assert_fact_once(Asker, ?ASKER_NS, s8_effect_mark, Tag),
 1790:     wait_ready(Target, CreatedNs, {s8_effect_created, ok}),
 1791:     Anchor = peer:call(Target, quod_simplex, genesis_hash, [CreatedNs]),
 1792:     ?assertMatch(<<_:256>>, Anchor),
 1793:     assert_operation_redelivery(Config, Op, Rows, #{?ASKER_NS => Asker, ?ROOT_NS => Target}),
 1794:     ?assertEqual(Anchor, peer:call(Target, quod_simplex, genesis_hash, [CreatedNs])),
 1795:     assert_fact_once(Asker, ?ASKER_NS, s8_effect_mark, Tag),
 1796:     #{included := Receipt} = peer:call(Asker, quod_ct, await_operation_complete,
 1797:                                       [?ASKER_NS, Op, 5000], 10000),
 1798:     ?assert(quod_operation_vector:certified(Receipt)).
 1799: 
 1800: remote_independent_routes(Config) ->
 1801:     Asker = ?config(asker, Config),
 1802:     Target = ?config(target, Config),
 1803:     ?assertMatch({ok, _, {normalized, {answers, _, [_]}}},
 1804:       submit_signed_execute(Config, <<"animals::independent(true).">>)),
 1805:     Tag = erlang:unique_integer([positive]),
 1806:     Text = iolist_to_binary(io_lib:format(
 1807:       "animals::independent(assertz(s6_remote(~B))).", [Tag])),
 1808:     {ok, Evidence, {normalized, {committed, [_], Ref}}} =
 1809:         submit_signed_execute(Config, Text),
 1810:     ?assertMatch({transaction, ?NS, _, _}, Ref),
 1811:     ?assertEqual(Ref, completed_remote_operation(
 1812:                        Asker, maps:get(operation_ref, Evidence), 600)),
 1813:     assert_fact_once(Target, ?NS, s6_remote, Tag),
 1814:     lists:foreach(fun(Goal) ->
 1815:         ?assertMatch({ok, _, {normalized, {committed, [_], {operation_outcome, _, [_, _]}}}},
 1816:                      submit_signed_execute(Config, Goal))
 1817:     end, [<<"independent((assertz(s6_ab), animals::assertz(s6_ab))).">>,
 1818:           <<"animals::independent((assertz(s6_bc), third::assertz(s6_bc))).">>]),
 1819:     lists:foreach(fun({Peer, Ns, Fact}) ->
 1820:         ?assertMatch({ok, [_], _}, peer:call(Peer, quod_prolog, prove, [Ns, Fact]))
 1821:     end, [{Asker, ?ASKER_NS, s6_ab}, {Target, ?NS, s6_ab},
 1822:           {Target, ?NS, s6_bc}, {?config(third, Config), ?THIRD_NS, s6_bc}]).
 1823: 
 1824: %% L2-S8-DEFERRED-7.4-ADMITTED-PARTIAL-OUTCOME: both plans are genuinely
 1825: %% sealed, then one target's read becomes stale before claim admission. The
 1826: %% shared applier rejects ONLY that target. No hand-built claim or bypass.
 1827: remote_independent_partial_outcome(Config) ->
 1828:     require_third_route_at_target(Config),
 1829:     Asker = ?config(asker, Config), Target = ?config(target, Config),
 1830:     Third = ?config(third, Config), Tag = erlang:unique_integer([positive]),
 1831:     Goal = iolist_to_binary(io_lib:format(
 1832:       "animals::independent((diet(dog, kibble), assertz(s8_rejected(~B)), third::dtx_write(~B))).",
 1833:       [Tag, Tag])),
 1834:     ok = peer:call(Asker, quod_prolog, test_install_read_certificate_barrier, []),
 1835:     Parent = self(), RequestRef = make_ref(),
 1836:     _ = spawn(fun() -> Parent ! {RequestRef, submit_signed_execute(Config, Goal)} end),
 1837:     try
 1838:         ok = peer:call(Asker, quod_prolog, test_await_read_certificate_barrier, [3000]),
 1839:         ?assertMatch({ok, [_], _}, peer:call(Target, quod_prolog, prove,
 1840:           [?NS, {assertz, {diet, dog, {s8_stale_marker, Tag}}}], 60000))
 1841:     after
 1842:         _ = peer:call(Asker, quod_prolog, test_release_read_certificate_barrier, [])
 1843:     end,
 1844:     {ok, Evidence, {normalized, {committed, [_], {operation_outcome, Op, Rows}}}} =
 1845:         receive {RequestRef, Value} -> Value
 1846:         after 60000 -> ct:fail(independent_partial_outcome_timeout) end,
 1847:     ?assertEqual(maps:get(operation_ref, Evidence), Op),
 1848:     ?assertEqual(mixed, quod_operation_vector:aggregate(Rows)),
 1849:     ?assertMatch([{{?NS, _}, {{rejected, conflict_retry}, _}},
 1850:                   {{?THIRD_NS, _}, {committed, _}}], Rows),
 1851:     assert_fact_absent(Target, ?NS, s8_rejected, Tag),
 1852:     assert_fact_once(Third, ?THIRD_NS, dtx_third_mark, Tag),
 1853:     %% Repeat exact delivery after mixed completion: rejected A stays rejected,
 1854:     %% committed B stays exactly once, and neither gets a fresh application id.
 1855:     assert_operation_redelivery(Config, Op, Rows, #{?NS => Target, ?THIRD_NS => Third}),
 1856:     assert_fact_absent(Target, ?NS, s8_rejected, Tag),
 1857:     assert_fact_once(Third, ?THIRD_NS, dtx_third_mark, Tag),
 1858:     %% The source owner must recover the same complete vector for a later
 1859:     %% caller. A different gateway then verifies the source receipt and the
 1860:     %% exact AM3 target evidence; current-view status labels are insufficient.
 1861:     SessionId = maps:get(session_id, ?config(client_session, Config)),
 1862:     RequestBytes = maps:get(request_bytes, Evidence), Signature = maps:get(signature, Evidence),
 1863:     ?assertMatch({ok, _, {operation_outcome, _, #{status := completed, targets := Rows}}},
 1864:       peer:call(Asker, quod_client_goal_ingress, resolve_operation,
 1865:         [SessionId, RequestBytes, Signature, ?config(client_peer, Config)], 10000)),
 1866:     ForeignSession = open_client_session(Target, ?config(network_id, Config),
 1867:       ?config(target_pub, Config), ?config(agent_key, Config), ?config(client_peer, Config)),
 1868:     ?assertMatch({ok, _, {operation_outcome, _, #{status := completed, targets := Rows}}},
 1869:       wait_remote_operation(Target, maps:get(session_id, ForeignSession), RequestBytes,
 1870:         Signature, ?config(client_peer, Config), 8)).
 1871: 
 1872: 
 1873: assert_operation_redelivery(Config, Op, Rows, Owners) ->
 1874:     Asker = ?config(asker, Config),
 1875:     {ok, #{height := Slot}} = peer:call(Asker, quod_prolog, local_outcome, [?ASKER_NS, Op]),
 1876:     Deadline = peer:call(Asker, quod_time, mono_ms, []) + 5000,
 1877:     {ok, ClaimRef, Claim} = peer:call(Asker, quod_simplex, operation_claim_evidence,
 1878:                                     [?ASKER_NS, Slot, Op, Deadline]),
 1879:     {ok, Bytes} = quod_transaction:encode_evidence(ClaimRef, Claim),
 1880:     lists:foreach(fun({Identity = {Ns, _}, {Verdict, Ref}}) ->
 1881:         Peer = maps:get(Ns, Owners),
 1882:         {transaction, _, _, TxId} = Ref,
 1883:         Before = peer:call(Peer, ?MODULE, claim_application_occurrences, [Ns, TxId]),
 1884:         ?assertMatch([_], Before),
 1885:         lists:foreach(fun(_) ->
 1886:             ?assertEqual({ok, Bytes}, quod_transaction:encode_evidence(ClaimRef, Claim)),
 1887:             Id = crypto:strong_rand_bytes(16), Request = {apply_claim, Id, Identity, Bytes},
 1888:             ?assertMatch({ok, {application, Id, Verdict, _}, _Hints}, peer:call(
 1889:               Asker, quod_dtx_current_view, submit_claim_application,
 1890:               [?ASKER_NS, Identity, Claim, Request, 5000], 10000)),
 1891:             ?assertEqual(Before, peer:call(Peer, ?MODULE, claim_application_occurrences, [Ns, TxId]))
 1892:         end, [first, second])
 1893:     end, Rows).
 1894: 
 1895: %% Positive atomic/reconnect cases establish their own route precondition. A prior
 1896: %% case may already have installed this exact fixture route; verify it then,
 1897: %% never erase it or rely on a particular suite order. Negative/recovery
 1898: %% route cases use the separately isolated read-set suite.
 1899: require_third_route_at_target(Config) ->
 1900:     Peer = ?config(target, Config), Key = ?config(third_pub, Config),
 1901:     Endpoint = ?config(third_addr, Config),
 1902:     Identity = {?THIRD_NS, ?config(third_anchor, Config)},
 1903:     case peer:call(Peer, quod_foreign_log, route_hints, [Identity, []]) of
 1904:         {error, unavailable} ->
 1905:             {ok, _} = peer:call(Peer, quod_ct, install_directory_generation,
 1906:               [Key, Endpoint, [{?THIRD_NS, element(2, Identity), validator}], 1, 1]);
 1907:         {ok, _} -> ok
 1908:     end,
 1909:     {ok, Routes} = peer:call(Peer, quod_foreign_log, route_hints, [Identity, []]),
 1910:     {Key, Endpoints} = lists:keyfind(Key, 1, Routes),
 1911:     ?assert(lists:member(Endpoint, Endpoints)),
 1912:     ok.
 1913: 
 1914: remote_independent_branch_provenance(Config) ->
 1915:     ok = require_third_route_at_target(Config),
 1916:     Target = ?config(target, Config),
 1917:     Third = ?config(third, Config),
 1918:     %% The original signed request and real sealed retained writes choose L3.
 1919:     ?assertMatch({ok, _, {normalized, {committed, [_], {group_outcome, _, _, _}}}},
 1920:       submit_signed_execute(Config,
 1921:         <<"animals::((independent((assertz(s6_f1), third::assertz(s6_f1), fail))); true).">>)),
 1922:     ?assertMatch({ok, [#{}], _},
 1923:                  peer:call(Target, quod_prolog, prove, [?NS, s6_f1])),
 1924:     ?assertMatch({ok, [_], _}, peer:call(Third, quod_prolog, prove, [?THIRD_NS, s6_f1])),
 1925:     ?assertMatch({ok, _, {normalized, {error, independent_mixed_writes}}},
 1926:       submit_signed_execute(Config,
 1927:         <<"animals::(((assertz(s6_f2), fail); true), independent(third::assertz(s6_f2))).">>)),
 1928:     ?assertMatch({ok, _, {normalized, {committed, [_], {operation_outcome, _, [_, _]}}}},
 1929:       submit_signed_execute(Config,
 1930:         <<"animals::((independent((assertz(s6_f3), fail)); true), independent(third::assertz(s6_f3))).">>)),
 1931:     %% A remotely-produced successful marker must unwind at its caller too.
 1932:     ?assertMatch({ok, _, {normalized, {committed, [_], {group_outcome, _, _, _}}}},
 1933:       submit_signed_execute(Config,
 1934:         <<"((animals::independent((assertz(s6_unwound), third::assertz(s6_unwound))), fail); true).">>)),
 1935:     lists:foreach(fun(Fact) ->
 1936:         ?assertMatch({fail, _}, peer:call(Target, quod_prolog, prove, [?NS, Fact])),
 1937:         ?assertMatch({fail, _}, peer:call(Third, quod_prolog, prove, [?THIRD_NS, Fact]))
 1938:     end, [s6_f2]),
 1939:     ?assertMatch({ok, [_], _}, peer:call(Target, quod_prolog, prove, [?NS, s6_f3])),
 1940:     ?assertMatch({ok, [_], _}, peer:call(Third, quod_prolog, prove, [?THIRD_NS, s6_f3])).

 1961: remote_independent_cursor_selects_only_accepted_answer(Config) ->
 1962:     Asker = ?config(asker, Config),
 1963:     Session = ?config(client_session, Config),
 1964:     SessionId = maps:get(session_id, Session),
 1965:     ClientPeer = ?config(client_peer, Config),
 1966:     lists:foreach(fun(AcceptSecond) ->
 1967:         Tag = erlang:unique_integer([positive]),
 1968:         Text = iolist_to_binary(io_lib:format(
 1969:           "animals::((independent((assertz(s6_cursor(~B)), third::assertz(s6_cursor(~B)))), X=first); X=second).",
 1970:           [Tag, Tag])),
 1971:         {Bytes, Signature} = signed_goal_request(
 1972:           ?config(network_id, Config), ?config(agent_pub, Config), ?config(agent_key, Config),
 1973:           ?ASKER_NS, ?config(asker_anchor, Config), maps:get(expires_ms, Session), cursor, Text),
 1974:         {ok, _, {normalized, {solution, CursorId, _, First}}} = peer:call(
 1975:           Asker, quod_client_goal_ingress, submit,
 1976:           [cursor, SessionId, Bytes, Signature, ClientPeer], 60000),
 1977:         ?assertEqual({ok, [{<<"X">>, first}]}, quod_durable_term:decode_result(First)),
 1978:         case AcceptSecond of
 1979:             false -> ok;
 1980:             true ->
 1981:                 {ok, _, {normalized, {solution, CursorId, _, Second}}} = peer:call(
 1982:                   Asker, quod_client_goal_ingress, cursor_command,
 1983:                   [SessionId, CursorId, next, ClientPeer], 60000),
 1984:                 ?assertEqual({ok, [{<<"X">>, second}]},
 1985:                              quod_durable_term:decode_result(Second))
 1986:         end,
 1987:         Result = peer:call(Asker, quod_client_goal_ingress, cursor_command,
 1988:                           [SessionId, CursorId, accept, ClientPeer], 60000),
 1989:         case AcceptSecond of
 1990:             false ->
 1991:                 ?assertMatch({ok, _, {normalized,
 1992:                              {committed, [_], {operation_outcome, _, [_, _]}}}}, Result),
 1993:                 assert_fact_once(?config(target, Config), ?NS, s6_cursor, Tag),
 1994:                 assert_fact_once(?config(third, Config), ?THIRD_NS, s6_cursor, Tag);
 1995:             true ->
 1996:                 ?assertMatch({ok, _, {normalized,
 1997:                                      {committed, [_], {group_outcome, _, _, _}}}}, Result),
 1998:                 assert_fact_once(?config(target, Config), ?NS, s6_cursor, Tag),
 1999:                 assert_fact_once(?config(third, Config), ?THIRD_NS, s6_cursor, Tag)
 2000:         end
 2001:     end, [false, true]).
