 2003: remote_signed_gateway_group(Config) ->
 2004:     Asker = ?config(asker, Config),
 2005:     Target = ?config(target, Config),
 2006:     Third = ?config(third, Config),
 2007:     NetworkId = ?config(network_id, Config),
 2008:     AgentKey = ?config(agent_key, Config),
 2009:     AgentPub = ?config(agent_pub, Config),
 2010:     Session = ?config(client_session, Config),
 2011:     Peer = ?config(client_peer, Config),
 2012: 
 2013:     AgentAnchor = ?config(asker_anchor, Config),
 2014:     ok = require_third_route_at_target(Config),
 2015:     %% Third already received Target's exact current record in suite setup.
 2016:     %% Reinstalling sequence 1 here would correctly be rejected as stale.
 2017:     Tag = erlang:unique_integer([positive]),
 2018:     GroupText = iolist_to_binary(
 2019:                   io_lib:format(
 2020:                     "\"animals\"::dtx_write_chain(~B).", [Tag])),
 2021:     {GroupBytes, GroupSignature} = signed_goal_request(
 2022:                                      NetworkId, AgentPub, AgentKey,
 2023:                                      ?ASKER_NS, AgentAnchor,
 2024:                                      maps:get(expires_ms, Session), execute,
 2025:                                      GroupText),
 2026:     {ok, GroupEvidence,
 2027:      {normalized,
 2028:       {committed, [_],
 2029:        {group_outcome,
 2030:         {group, ?ASKER_NS, AgentAnchor, _, _, _} = GroupRef,
 2031:         _, Slots}}}} =
 2032:         peer:call(
 2033:           Asker, quod_client_goal_ingress, submit,
 2034:           [execute, maps:get(session_id, Session), GroupBytes,
 2035:            GroupSignature, Peer], 60000),
 2036:     %% O participates even when both writable scopes are remote.
 2037:     ?assertEqual(3, length(Slots)),
 2038:     assert_fact_once(Target, ?NS, dtx_animals_mark, Tag),
 2039:     assert_fact_once(Third, ?THIRD_NS, dtx_third_mark, Tag),
 2040:     ?assertMatch(
 2041:        {ok, #{status := claimed, outcome_ref := GroupRef}},
 2042:        peer:call(
 2043:          Asker, quod_prolog, outcome,
 2044:          [maps:get(operation_ref, GroupEvidence)])),
 2045:     ok.
 2046: 
 2047: %% Eight independently signed, non-conflicting A -> B -> C writes enter
 2048: %% together. Each writes distinct predicate heads on B and C, so this exercises
 2049: %% the conflict-safe batch path rather than the separate wait-die abort test
 2050: %% below. The old single handoff slot rejected this shape as busy.
 2051: remote_signed_concurrent_gateway_groups(Config) ->
 2052:     ok = require_third_route_at_target(Config),
 2053:     Asker = ?config(asker, Config),
 2054:     Target = ?config(target, Config),
 2055:     Third = ?config(third, Config),
 2056:     NetworkId = ?config(network_id, Config),
 2057:     AgentKey = ?config(agent_key, Config),
 2058:     AgentPub = ?config(agent_pub, Config),
 2059:     Session = ?config(client_session, Config),
 2060:     ClientPeer = ?config(client_peer, Config),
 2061:     AgentAnchor = ?config(asker_anchor, Config),
 2062:     PredicateRows = dtx_disjoint_predicates(),
 2063:     Requests =
 2064:         [begin
 2065:              Tag = erlang:unique_integer([positive]),
 2066:              GoalText = iolist_to_binary(
 2067:                           io_lib:format(
 2068:                             "\"animals\"::~s(~B).",
 2069:                             [atom_to_list(ChainPredicate), Tag])),
 2070:              {RequestBytes, Signature} = signed_goal_request(
 2071:                                            NetworkId, AgentPub, AgentKey,
 2072:                                            ?ASKER_NS, AgentAnchor,
 2073:                                            maps:get(expires_ms, Session),
 2074:                                            execute, GoalText),
 2075:              {Index, Tag, LocalPredicate, RemotePredicate,
 2076:               RequestBytes, Signature}
 2077:          end || {Index, {ChainPredicate, LocalPredicate,
 2078:                          _RemoteWriter, RemotePredicate}} <-
 2079:                     lists:zip(lists:seq(1, 8), PredicateRows)],
 2080:     Parent = self(),
 2081:     ConcurrentRef = make_ref(),
 2082:     Writers =
 2083:         [spawn(
 2084:            fun() ->
 2085:                receive {ConcurrentRef, go} -> ok end,
 2086:                Result = peer:call(
 2087:                           Asker, quod_client_goal_ingress, submit,
 2088:                           [execute, maps:get(session_id, Session),
 2089:                            RequestBytes, Signature, ClientPeer], 60000),
 2090:                Parent ! {ConcurrentRef, Index, Result}
 2091:            end)
 2092:          || {Index, _Tag, _LocalPredicate, _RemotePredicate,
 2093:              RequestBytes, Signature} <- Requests],
 2094:     lists:foreach(fun(Pid) -> Pid ! {ConcurrentRef, go} end, Writers),
 2095:     Results = collect_gateway_race(ConcurrentRef, length(Requests), []),
 2096:     EvidenceByIndex =
 2097:         maps:from_list(
 2098:           [{Index, concurrent_submit_evidence(Index, Result)}
 2099:            || {Index, Result} <- Results]),
 2100:     OperationRefs =
 2101:         [maps:get(operation_ref, maps:get(Index, EvidenceByIndex))
 2102:          || {Index, _Tag, _LocalPredicate, _RemotePredicate,
 2103:              _RequestBytes, _Signature} <- Requests],
 2104:     ?assertEqual(length(Requests), length(lists:usort(OperationRefs))),
 2105:     lists:foreach(
 2106:       fun({Index, Tag, LocalPredicate, RemotePredicate,
 2107:            _RequestBytes, _Signature}) ->
 2108:           OperationRef = maps:get(
 2109:                            operation_ref, maps:get(Index, EvidenceByIndex)),
 2110:           {#{status := claimed, outcome_ref := GroupRef},
 2111:            #{status := committed, participant_slots := Slots}} =
 2112:               wait_operation_claim(Asker, OperationRef, 600),
 2113:           ?assertMatch(
 2114:              {group, ?ASKER_NS, AgentAnchor, _, _, _}, GroupRef),
 2115:           ?assertEqual(3, length(Slots)),
 2116:           assert_fact_once(Target, ?NS, LocalPredicate, Tag),
 2117:           assert_fact_once(Third, ?THIRD_NS, RemotePredicate, Tag)
 2118:       end, Requests),
 2119:     Stats = peer:call(Asker, quod_simplex, stats, [?ASKER_NS]),
 2120:     ?assertEqual(0, maps:get(dtx_admission_waiting, Stats)),
 2121:     ?assertEqual(0, maps:get(dtx_admission_dormant, Stats)),
 2122:     ok.
 2123: 
 2124: %% Both proofs read conflict_version/1 while it is zero, then wait at the
 2125: %% pre-Vote FIFO seam. One group changes that fact; the other must retain its
 2126: %% claimed operation id and terminate with the ordinary stale-read abort.
 2127: remote_signed_queued_occ_abort(Config) ->
 2128:     Asker = ?config(asker, Config),
 2129:     Target = ?config(target, Config),
 2130:     Third = ?config(third, Config),
 2131:     NetworkId = ?config(network_id, Config),
 2132:     AgentKey = ?config(agent_key, Config),
 2133:     AgentPub = ?config(agent_pub, Config),
 2134:     ClientPeer = ?config(client_peer, Config),
 2135:     AgentAnchor = ?config(asker_anchor, Config),
 2136:     Session = open_client_session(
 2137:                 Asker, NetworkId, ?config(asker_pub, Config),
 2138:                 AgentKey, ClientPeer),
 2139:     Requests =
 2140:         [begin
 2141:              Tag = erlang:unique_integer([positive]),
 2142:              GoalText = iolist_to_binary(
 2143:                           io_lib:format(
 2144:                             "\"animals\"::dtx_conflicting_write(~B).",
 2145:                             [Tag])),
 2146:              {RequestBytes, Signature} = signed_goal_request(
 2147:                                            NetworkId, AgentPub, AgentKey,
 2148:                                            ?ASKER_NS, AgentAnchor,
 2149:                                            maps:get(expires_ms, Session),
 2150:                                            execute, GoalText),
 2151:              {Index, Tag, RequestBytes, Signature}
 2152:          end || Index <- [1, 2]],
 2153:     Parent = self(),
 2154:     RaceRef = make_ref(),
 2155:     Writers =
 2156:         [spawn(
 2157:            fun() ->
 2158:                receive {RaceRef, go} -> ok end,
 2159:                Result = peer:call(
 2160:                           Asker, quod_client_goal_ingress, submit,
 2161:                           [execute, maps:get(session_id, Session),
 2162:                            RequestBytes, Signature, ClientPeer], 60000),
 2163:                Parent ! {RaceRef, Index, Result}
 2164:            end)
 2165:          || {Index, _Tag, RequestBytes, Signature} <- Requests],
 2166:     lists:foreach(fun(Pid) -> Pid ! {RaceRef, go} end, Writers),
 2167:     Evidences = maps:from_list(
 2168:                   [{Index, concurrent_conflict_evidence(Index, Result)}
 2169:                    || {Index, Result} <-
 2170:                           collect_gateway_race(RaceRef, 2, [])]),
 2171:     Outcomes =
 2172:         [{Index, Tag, RequestBytes, Signature,
 2173:           wait_operation_terminal(
 2174:             Asker, maps:get(operation_ref, maps:get(Index, Evidences)), 600)}
 2175:          || {Index, Tag, RequestBytes, Signature} <- Requests],
 2176:     [{CommittedIndex, CommittedTag, _CommittedBytes, _CommittedSignature,
 2177:       {_, #{status := committed}}}] =
 2178:         [Row || Row = {_, _, _, _, {_, #{status := committed}}} <- Outcomes],
 2179:     [{AbortedIndex, AbortedTag, AbortedBytes, AbortedSignature,
 2180:       {#{status := claimed}, #{status := aborted}}}] =
 2181:         [Row || Row = {_, _, _, _,
 2182:                        {#{status := claimed}, #{status := aborted}}} <- Outcomes],
 2183:     ?assertNotEqual(CommittedIndex, AbortedIndex),
 2184:     assert_fact_once(Target, ?NS, dtx_conflict_mark, CommittedTag),
 2185:     assert_fact_absent(Target, ?NS, dtx_conflict_mark, AbortedTag),
 2186:     assert_fact_once(Third, ?THIRD_NS, dtx_third_mark, CommittedTag),
 2187:     ?assertMatch(
 2188:        {ok, _, {operation_outcome,
 2189:                 #{status := claimed}, #{status := aborted}}},
 2190:        wait_remote_operation(
 2191:          Asker, maps:get(session_id, Session), AbortedBytes,
 2192:          AbortedSignature, ClientPeer, 8)),
 2193:     ok.
 2194: 
 2195: %% One signed proof writes its agent ontology and stages Root's existing
 2196: %% create-ontology effect.  Root is hosted on another peer, so this exercises
 2197: %% the real scope custody command, not only the co-hosted session path.
 2198: remote_signed_gateway_group_with_root_effect(Config) ->
 2199:     Asker = ?config(asker, Config),
 2200:     Target = ?config(target, Config),
 2201:     NetworkId = ?config(network_id, Config),
 2202:     AgentKey = ?config(agent_key, Config),
 2203:     AgentPub = ?config(agent_pub, Config),
 2204:     Session = ?config(client_session, Config),
 2205:     Peer = ?config(client_peer, Config),
 2206:     AgentAnchor = ?config(asker_anchor, Config),
 2207:     Tag = erlang:unique_integer([positive]),
 2208:     CreatedNs = iolist_to_binary(
 2209:                   ["ct:remote-effect-", integer_to_binary(Tag)]),
 2210:     GoalText = root_effect_goal(Tag, CreatedNs),
 2211:     {RequestBytes, Signature} = signed_goal_request(
 2212:                                   NetworkId, AgentPub, AgentKey,
 2213:                                   ?ASKER_NS, AgentAnchor,
 2214:                                   maps:get(expires_ms, Session), execute,
 2215:                                   GoalText),
 2216:     {ok, _Evidence,
 2217:      {normalized,
 2218:       {committed, [_],
 2219:        {group_outcome,
 2220:         {group, ?ASKER_NS, AgentAnchor, _, _, _} = GroupRef,
 2221:         _, Slots}}}} =
 2222:         peer:call(
 2223:           Asker, quod_client_goal_ingress, submit,
 2224:           [execute, maps:get(session_id, Session), RequestBytes,
 2225:            Signature, Peer], 60000),
 2226:     ?assertEqual(2, length(Slots)),
 2227:     assert_fact_once(Asker, ?ASKER_NS, signed_pets_mark, Tag),
 2228:     %% Group application records the effect obligation; the existing effect
 2229:     %% owner starts the ontology asynchronously. Observe its completion before
 2230:     %% asking the new ontology to prove a goal.
 2231:     wait_remote_effect_state(Target, CreatedNs, GroupRef, applied, 300),
 2232:     wait_ready(Target, CreatedNs, {remote_effect_created, ok}),
 2233:     ok.
 2234: 
 2235: root_effect_goal(Tag, CreatedNs) ->
 2236:     iolist_to_binary(io_lib:format(
 2237:       "assertz(signed_pets_mark(~B)), "
 2238:       "\"quod:root\"::create_ontology(\"~s\", "
 2239:       "[source(\"can_invoke(_, _, _, _).\\n"
 2240:       "remote_effect_created(ok).\\n\")], _Anchor).", [Tag, CreatedNs])).
 2241: 
 2242: %% A real remote effect is durably bound, but the source never activates.
 2243: %% OTP's installed debug callback holds the existing activation call before
 2244: %% handle_call, without a production hook or a send/receipt ordering guess.
 2245: remote_bound_effect_recovers_without_activation(Config) ->
 2246:     Asker = ?config(asker, Config), Target = ?config(target, Config),
 2247:     OldEngine = peer:call(Asker, quod_reg, where, [{quod_prolog, ?ASKER_NS}]),
 2248:     OldSimplex = peer:call(Asker, quod_reg, where, [{quod_simplex, ?ASKER_NS}]),
 2249:     Gate = {?MODULE, before_activation},
 2250:     ok = peer:call(Asker, sys, install,
 2251:                    [OldEngine, {Gate, fun ?MODULE:hold_group_activation/3, armed}]),
 2252:     Tag = erlang:unique_integer([positive]),
 2253:     CreatedNs = iolist_to_binary(["ct:aborted-effect-", integer_to_binary(Tag)]),
 2254:     Session = ?config(client_session, Config),
 2255:     %% Choose the request's original bound once; never extend it after failure.
 2256:     Expires = min(maps:get(expires_ms, Session), quod_time:now_ms() + 10000),
 2257:     {Bytes, Signature} = signed_goal_request(
 2258:       ?config(network_id, Config), ?config(agent_pub, Config), ?config(agent_key, Config),
 2259:       ?ASKER_NS, ?config(asker_anchor, Config), Expires, execute,
 2260:       root_effect_goal(Tag, CreatedNs)),
 2261:     Parent = self(), CallRef = make_ref(), ClientPeer = ?config(client_peer, Config),
 2262:     spawn(fun() -> Parent ! {CallRef, peer:call(Asker, quod_client_goal_ingress,
 2263:       submit, [execute, maps:get(session_id, Session), Bytes, Signature, ClientPeer], 60000)} end),
 2264:     try
 2265:         {GroupRef, _Token} = wait_activation_gate(Asker, CallRef, 300),
 2266:         wait_remote_effect_state(Target, CreatedNs, GroupRef, group_pending, 50),
 2267:         {running, OwnerState} = peer:call(Asker, sys, get_state, [OldSimplex]),
 2268:         ?assertMatch(#{active := 0, reserved := 1}, peer:call(
 2269:           Asker, quod_simplex, test_dtx_admission_state, [OwnerState])),
 2270:         Journal = peer:call(Asker, quod_simplex, test_signing_journal, [OwnerState]),
 2271:         {group, _, _, _, _, Id} = GroupRef,
 2272:         #{Id := #{sequence := 0, envelope := none,
 2273:                   material := {{quod_dtx_vote, 4, Group, _, none, _}, _, _}}} =
 2274:             peer:call(Asker, quod_signing_journal, pending_dtx, [Journal]),
 2275:         %% Source responsibility already retains the exact original request,
 2276:         %% before activation or any source Vote. It is not just a generated
 2277:         %% operation ID that a later hosted incarnation would have to recreate.
 2278:         Digest = crypto:hash(sha256,Bytes),
 2279:         ?assertMatch({quod_atomic_group,4,_,{agent_goal_v1,Digest,Bytes,Signature},_},Group),
 2280:         {ok,#{request := #{evidence := #{agent_ref_blob := AgentBytes}}}} =
 2281:             peer:call(Asker,quod_atomic,group_binding,[Group]),
 2282:         ?assertEqual(#{Id => true},peer:call(Asker,?MODULE,agent_custody_snapshot,[OldSimplex,AgentBytes])),
 2283:         true = peer:call(Asker, erlang, exit, [OldEngine, kill]),
 2284:         true = peer:call(Asker, erlang, exit, [OldSimplex, kill]),
 2285:         receive {CallRef, Result} ->
 2286:             ?assertNotMatch({ok, _, {normalized, {committed, _, _}}}, Result)
 2287:         after 10000 -> ct:fail(bound_effect_caller_did_not_observe_crash)
 2288:         end,
 2289:         wait_restarted(Asker, ?ASKER_NS, OldSimplex, 400),
 2290:         ?assertMatch(#{status := aborted, ref := GroupRef},
 2291:                      wait_group_outcome(Asker, GroupRef, 600)),
 2292:         wait_remote_effect_state(Target, CreatedNs, GroupRef, retired, 300),
 2293:         assert_fact_absent(Asker, ?ASKER_NS, signed_pets_mark, Tag),
 2294:         ?assertEqual(undefined, peer:call(Target, quod_reg, where, [{quod_simplex, CreatedNs}])),
 2295:         assert_dtx_released(Asker, ?ASKER_NS),
 2296:         assert_dtx_released(Target, ?ROOT_NS)
 2297:     after
 2298:         %% Release only this test gate if setup failed before the injected kill.
 2299:         case peer:call(Asker, application, get_env, [quod, ct_activation_gate]) of
 2300:             {ok, {_Ref, Release}} -> peer:call(Asker, erlang, send, [OldEngine, {release, Release}]);
 2301:             _ -> ok
 2302:         end,
 2303:         _ = catch peer:call(Asker, sys, remove, [OldEngine, Gate]),
 2304:         _ = peer:call(Asker, application, unset_env, [quod, ct_activation_gate])
 2305:     end.
 2306: 
 2307: agent_custody_snapshot(Owner, Agent) ->
 2308:     Token = make_ref(), Monitor = monitor(process,Owner),
 2309:     Owner ! {agent_work_custody,self(),Token,Agent,all},
 2310:     try receive
 2311:         {agent_work_custody,Owner,Token,Rows} -> Rows;
 2312:         {'DOWN',Monitor,process,Owner,Reason} -> error({custody_owner_down,Reason})
 2313:     after 5000 -> error(custody_snapshot_missing)
 2314:     end after demonitor(Monitor,[flush]) end.
 2315: 
 2316: hold_group_activation(armed, {in, {'$gen_call', _, {activate_dtx_vote, _, GroupRef}}}, _) ->
 2317:     Token = make_ref(),
 2318:     ok = application:set_env(quod, ct_activation_gate, {GroupRef, Token}),
 2319:     receive {release, Token} -> ok after 15000 -> ok end,
 2320:     done;
 2321: hold_group_activation(State, _Event, _Name) -> State.
 2322: 
 2323: wait_activation_gate(_Peer, _CallRef, 0) -> ct:fail(activation_gate_timeout);
 2324: wait_activation_gate(Peer, CallRef, Retries) ->
 2325:     case peer:call(Peer, application, get_env, [quod, ct_activation_gate]) of
 2326:         {ok, {_, _} = Held} -> Held;
 2327:         _ ->
 2328:             receive {CallRef, Result} -> ct:fail({proof_ended_before_activation, Result})
 2329:             after 20 -> wait_activation_gate(Peer, CallRef, Retries - 1)
 2330:             end
 2331:     end.
 2332: 
 2333: %% One browser-equivalent request crosses two remote scope hops and commits
 2334: %% through the ordinary group protocol.
 2335: remote_signed_group_uses_exact_agent_request(Config) ->
 2336:     Asker = ?config(asker, Config),
 2337:     NetworkId = ?config(network_id, Config),
 2338:     AgentKey = ?config(agent_key, Config),
 2339:     AgentPub = ?config(agent_pub, Config),
 2340:     Session = ?config(client_session, Config),
 2341:     Peer = ?config(client_peer, Config),
 2342:     Anchor = ?config(asker_anchor, Config),
 2343:     Tag = erlang:unique_integer([positive]),
 2344:     GoalText = iolist_to_binary(
 2345:                  io_lib:format(
 2346:                    "assertz(signed_pets_mark(~B)), "
 2347:                    "\"animals\"::dtx_write_chain(~B).",
 2348:                    [Tag, Tag])),
 2349:     {RequestBytes, Signature} = signed_goal_request(
 2350:                                   NetworkId, AgentPub, AgentKey,
 2351:                                   ?ASKER_NS, Anchor,
 2352:                                   maps:get(expires_ms, Session), GoalText),
 2353:     {ok, Evidence, {normalized, SubmitResult}} = peer:call(
 2354:                                                    Asker,
 2355:                                                    quod_client_goal_ingress,
 2356:                                                    submit,
 2357:                                                    [execute,
 2358:                                                     maps:get(session_id,
 2359:                                                              Session),
 2360:                                                     RequestBytes, Signature,
 2361:                                                     Peer],
 2362:                                                    60000),
 2363:     {GroupRef, Outcome} =
 2364:         case SubmitResult of
 2365:             {committed, [_],
 2366:              {group_outcome,
 2367:               {group, ?ASKER_NS, Anchor, _, _, _} = Ref,
 2368:               Height, ParticipantSlots}} ->
 2369:                 {Ref, #{status => committed, ref => Ref, height => Height,
 2370:                         participant_slots => ParticipantSlots}};
 2371:             {pending, {group, ?ASKER_NS, Anchor, _, _, _} = Ref} ->
 2372:                 %% A transport timeout is uncertainty, never permission to
 2373:                 %% resubmit. Resolve the exact first group instead.
 2374:                 {Ref, wait_group_outcome(Asker, Ref, 600)}
 2375:         end,
 2376:     Slots = maps:get(participant_slots, Outcome),
 2377:     ?assertEqual(3, length(Slots)),
 2378:     assert_fact_once(Asker, ?ASKER_NS, signed_pets_mark, Tag),
 2379:     assert_fact_once(?config(target, Config), ?NS, dtx_animals_mark, Tag),
 2380:     assert_fact_once(?config(third, Config), ?THIRD_NS, dtx_third_mark, Tag),
 2381:     OperationRef = maps:get(operation_ref, Evidence),
 2382:     ?assertMatch(
 2383:        {ok, #{status := claimed, outcome_ref := GroupRef}},
 2384:        peer:call(Asker, quod_prolog, outcome, [OperationRef])).
 2385: 
 2386: %% The origin is stopped after the remote Vote wave, before any Resolve.
 2387: %% Recovery uses certified own-role material, never a re-proof or another
 2388: %% role's plan. The exact caller reference still finds the one terminal result.
 2389: remote_group_recovers_after_origin_crash(Config) ->
 2390:     ok = require_third_route_at_target(Config),
 2391:     Target = ?config(target, Config),
 2392:     Asker = ?config(asker, Config),
 2393:     Third = ?config(third, Config),
 2394:     Tag = erlang:unique_integer([positive]),
 2395:     Goal = {',', {assertz, {dtx_pets_mark, Tag}},
 2396:                  {'::', ?NS, {dtx_write_chain, Tag}}},
 2397:     VotePhase = {voted, {?NS, ?config(target_anchor, Config)}},
 2398:     ok = peer:call(
 2399:            Asker, application, set_env,
 2400:            [quod, dtx_test_phase_barrier, {hold, VotePhase}]),
 2401:     ?assertEqual(
 2402:        {ok, {hold, VotePhase}},
 2403:        peer:call(Asker, application, get_env,
 2404:                  [quod, dtx_test_phase_barrier])),
 2405:     Parent = self(),
 2406:     ProofRef = make_ref(),
 2407:     _ProofCaller = spawn(
 2408:                      fun() ->
 2409:                          Result = peer:call(
 2410:                                     Asker, quod_prolog, prove,
 2411:                                     [?ASKER_NS, Goal], 60000),
 2412:                          Parent ! {ProofRef, Result}
 2413:                      end),
 2414:     try
 2415:         GroupId = wait_vote_barrier(ProofRef, VotePhase, Config),
 2416:         %% No role has applied; each one's exact positive Vote must already
 2417:         %% be certified, making commit the only possible recovered outcome.
 2418:         lists:foreach(fun({Peer, Ns}) ->
 2419:             assert_prepared_vote(Peer, Ns, GroupId),
 2420:             assert_resolve_absent(Peer, Ns, GroupId)
 2421:         end, [{Asker, ?ASKER_NS}, {Target, ?NS}, {Third, ?THIRD_NS}]),
 2422:         {ok, {?ASKER_NS, Anchor, Coordinator, Admission}} =
 2423:             peer:call(Asker, quod_simplex, dtx_binding, [?ASKER_NS]),
 2424:         GroupRef = {group, ?ASKER_NS, Anchor,
 2425:                     Coordinator, Admission, GroupId},
 2426:         OldSimplex = peer:call(
 2427:                        Asker, quod_reg, where,
 2428:                        [{quod_simplex, ?ASKER_NS}]),
 2429:         true = is_pid(OldSimplex),
 2430:         %% The bounded test valve must still be holding the coordinator at
 2431:         %% the Vote wave. Otherwise a slow test could silently crash after a
 2432:         %% self-released gate and prove only a weaker recovery path.
 2433:         ?assertMatch(
 2434:            {ok, {held, GroupId, VotePhase, _}},
 2435:            peer:call(Asker, application, get_env,
 2436:                      [quod, dtx_test_phase_barrier])),
 2437:         %% Disable the one-shot barrier before restart: the replacement
 2438:         %% coordinator must be free to rediscover the Votes and continue.
 2439:         ok = peer:call(
 2440:                Asker, application, unset_env,
 2441:                [quod, dtx_test_phase_barrier]),
 2442:         true = peer:call(Asker, erlang, exit, [OldSimplex, kill]),
 2443:         ?assertEqual(
 2444:            {error, {outcome_unknown, GroupRef}},
 2445:            receive
 2446:                {ProofRef, ProofResult} -> ProofResult
 2447:            after 10000 ->
 2448:                ct:fail(proof_caller_did_not_observe_origin_crash)
 2449:            end),
 2450:         wait_restarted(Asker, ?ASKER_NS, OldSimplex, 400),
 2451:         Outcome = wait_group_outcome(Asker, GroupRef, 600),
 2452:         ?assertMatch(
 2453:            #{status := committed, ref := GroupRef,
 2454:              participant_slots := [_, _, _]}, Outcome),
 2455:         assert_fact_once(Asker, ?ASKER_NS, dtx_pets_mark, Tag),
 2456:         assert_fact_once(Target, ?NS, dtx_animals_mark, Tag),
 2457:         assert_fact_once(Third, ?THIRD_NS, dtx_third_mark, Tag),
 2458:         lists:foreach(
 2459:           fun({Peer, Ns}) -> assert_dtx_released(Peer, Ns) end,
 2460:           [{Asker, ?ASKER_NS}, {Target, ?NS}, {Third, ?THIRD_NS}])
 2461:     after
 2462:         _ = peer:call(
 2463:               Asker, application, unset_env,
 2464:               [quod, dtx_test_phase_barrier])
 2465:     end.
 2466: 
 2467: %% A route consumer knows the certified identities but starts with no live
 2468: %% route rows.  Each missing hop parks on the one exact directory property;
 2469: %% installing the ordinary complete generation wakes that same proof.  Four
 2470: %% ontology scopes are involved even though B and D share one physical node.
 2471: remote_four_scope_chain_recovers_empty_routes(Config) ->
 2472:     Asker = ?config(asker, Config),
 2473:     TargetIdentity = {?NS, ?config(target_anchor, Config)},
 2474:     ThirdIdentity = {?THIRD_NS, ?config(third_anchor, Config)},
 2475:     Before = peer:call(Asker, quod_directory_control, stats, []),
 2476:     ok = peer:call(Asker, quod_directory, expire, [1 bsl 60]),
 2477:     ?assertEqual(
 2478:        {known, []}, peer:call(Asker, quod_directory, resolve, [?NS])),
 2479:     ?assertEqual(
 2480:        {known, []}, peer:call(Asker, quod_directory, resolve, [?THIRD_NS])),
 2481:     Parent = self(),
 2482:     ProofRef = make_ref(),
 2483:     _Caller = spawn(
 2484:                 fun() ->
 2485:                     Result = peer:call(
 2486:                                Asker, quod_prolog, prove_ro,
 2487:                                [?ASKER_NS,
 2488:                                 {'::', ?NS, {via_fourth, {'X'}}}],
 2489:                                60000),
 2490:                     Parent ! {ProofRef, Result}
 2491:                 end),
 2492:     try
 2493:         ok = wait_route_demand(Asker, TargetIdentity, 500),
 2494:         ok = install_chain_target_generation(Config, 2),
 2495:         ok = wait_route_demand(Asker, ThirdIdentity, 500),
 2496:         ok = install_chain_third_generation(Config, 2),
 2497:         ?assertMatch(
 2498:            {ok, [#{'X' := _}], _},
 2499:            receive
 2500:                {ProofRef, ProofResult} -> ProofResult
 2501:            after 10000 ->
 2502:                ct:fail(four_scope_route_wake_timeout)
 2503:            end),
 2504:         After = peer:call(Asker, quod_directory_control, stats, []),
 2505:         ?assert(maps:get(route_demanded, After) >=
 2506:                     maps:get(route_demanded, Before) + 2),
 2507:         ?assert(maps:get(route_wakes, After) >=
 2508:                     maps:get(route_wakes, Before) + 2)
 2509:     after
 2510:         %% Restore complete generations even if the assertion failed so this
 2511:         %% suite never leaves a hidden route dependency for later cleanup.
 2512:         _ = install_chain_target_generation(Config, 3),
 2513:         _ = install_chain_third_generation(Config, 3)
 2514:     end.
 2515: 
 2516: wait_route_demand(_Peer, Identity, 0) ->
 2517:     ct:fail({route_demand_timeout, Identity});
 2518: wait_route_demand(Peer, Identity, Retries) ->
 2519:     case peer:call(Peer, quod_directory_control, test_control_state, []) of
 2520:         #{route_demands := Demands} ->
 2521:             case lists:member(Identity, Demands) of
 2522:                 true -> ok;
 2523:                 false ->
 2524:                     timer:sleep(10),
 2525:                     wait_route_demand(Peer, Identity, Retries - 1)
 2526:             end;
 2527:         _ ->
 2528:             timer:sleep(10),
 2529:             wait_route_demand(Peer, Identity, Retries - 1)
 2530:     end.
 2531: 
 2532: install_chain_target_generation(Config, Epoch) ->
 2533:     Asker = ?config(asker, Config),
 2534:     case peer:call(
 2535:            Asker, quod_ct, install_directory_generation,
 2536:            [?config(target_pub, Config), ?config(target_addr, Config),
 2537:             [{?NS, ?config(target_anchor, Config), validator},
 2538:              {?FOURTH_NS, ?config(fourth_anchor, Config), validator},
 2539:              {?ROOT_NS, ?config(network_id, Config), validator}],
 2540:             Epoch, 1]) of
 2541:         {ok, _} -> ok;
 2542:         Other -> Other
 2543:     end.
 2544: 
 2545: install_chain_third_generation(Config, Epoch) ->
 2546:     Asker = ?config(asker, Config),
 2547:     case peer:call(
 2548:            Asker, quod_ct, install_directory_generation,
 2549:            [?config(third_pub, Config), ?config(third_addr, Config),
 2550:             [{?THIRD_NS, ?config(third_anchor, Config), validator},
 2551:              {?NS, ?config(target_anchor, Config), observer}],
 2552:             Epoch, 1]) of
 2553:         {ok, _} -> ok;
 2554:         Other -> Other
 2555:     end.
 2556: 
 2557: wait_vote_barrier(ProofRef, Phase, Config) ->
 2558:     wait_vote_barrier(ProofRef, Phase, Config, 300).
 2559: 
 2560: wait_vote_barrier(_ProofRef, _Phase, Config, 0) ->
 2561:     ct:fail({dtx_vote_barrier_timeout, dtx_diagnostics(Config)});
 2562: wait_vote_barrier(ProofRef, Phase, Config, Retries) ->
 2563:     Asker = ?config(asker, Config),
 2564:     case peer:call(
 2565:            Asker, application, get_env,
 2566:            [quod, dtx_test_phase_barrier]) of
 2567:         {ok, {held, <<_:256>> = GroupId, Phase, _BarrierRef}} ->
 2568:             %% The gate is before the next planner drive, not a timed guess.
 2569:             GroupId;
 2570:         _ ->
 2571:             receive
 2572:                 {ProofRef, ProofResult} ->
 2573:                     ct:fail({group_proof_ended_before_vote, ProofResult})
 2574:             after 0 ->
 2575:                 timer:sleep(50),
 2576:                 wait_vote_barrier(ProofRef, Phase, Config, Retries - 1)
 2577:             end
 2578:     end.
 2579: 
 2580: assert_prepared_vote(Peer, Ns, GroupId) ->
 2581:     Request = {phase, crypto:strong_rand_bytes(16), GroupId, vote},
 2582:     {ok, {phase, _, _, {committed, Ref}}, _} = peer:call(
 2583:         Peer, quod_simplex, dtx_endpoint_local, [Ns, Request, [], 1000]),
 2584:     {ok, Identity, _, _} = quod_dtx:certified_ref_binding(Ref),
 2585:     Deadline = peer:call(Peer, quod_time, mono_ms, []) + 5000,
 2586:     {ok, #{control := Control}} = peer:call(Peer, quod_foreign_log,
 2587:         resolve_reference, [Identity, Ref, vote, none, none, Deadline]),
 2588:     ?assertMatch({quod_dtx_vote, 4, _, _, _, prepared},
 2589:                  quod_atomic:control_body(Control)).
 2590: 
 2591: assert_resolve_absent(Peer, Ns, GroupId) ->
 2592:     Request = {phase, crypto:strong_rand_bytes(16), GroupId, resolve},
 2593:     ?assertMatch(
 2594:        {ok, {phase, _, _, not_found}, []},
 2595:        peer:call(Peer, quod_simplex, dtx_endpoint_local,
 2596:                  [Ns, Request, [], 1000])).
 2597: 
 2598: wait_remote_effect_state(_Peer, Ns, GroupRef, Expected, 0) ->
 2599:     ct:fail({effect_state_timeout, Ns, GroupRef, Expected});
 2600: wait_remote_effect_state(Peer, Ns, GroupRef, Expected, Retries) ->
 2601:     Rows = peer:call(Peer, quod_effect_journal, rows, []),
 2602:     case [State || #{target := {RowNs, _}, ref := RowRef,
 2603:                      state := State} <- Rows,
 2604:                    RowNs =:= Ns,
 2605:                    element(1, RowRef) =:= group_effect,
 2606:                    element(3, RowRef) =:= GroupRef] of
 2607:         [Expected] -> ok;
 2608:         _ ->
 2609:             timer:sleep(20),
 2610:             wait_remote_effect_state(
 2611:               Peer, Ns, GroupRef, Expected, Retries - 1)
 2612:     end.
 2613: 
 2614: dtx_diagnostics(Config) ->
 2615:     Asker = ?config(asker, Config),
 2616:     Target = ?config(target, Config),
 2617:     Third = ?config(third, Config),
 2618:     Statuses =
 2619:         [{Ns, peer:call(Peer, quod_simplex, status, [Ns])}
 2620:          || {Peer, Ns} <- [{Asker, ?ASKER_NS}, {Target, ?NS},
 2621:                            {Third, ?THIRD_NS}]],
 2622:     GroupId =
 2623:         case proplists:get_value(?ASKER_NS, Statuses, #{}) of
 2624:             #{dtx_coordinators := Coordinators} ->
 2625:                 single_coordinator_id(Coordinators);
 2626:             _ -> undefined
 2627:         end,
 2628:     AskerInternal = dtx_internal_diagnostics(Asker, ?ASKER_NS),
 2629:     Phases =
 2630:         case GroupId of
 2631:             <<_:256>> ->
 2632:                 [{Ns,
 2633:                   [{Kind,
 2634:                     peer:call(
 2635:                       Peer, quod_simplex, dtx_endpoint_local,
 2636:                       [Ns, {phase, crypto:strong_rand_bytes(16),
 2637:                             GroupId, Kind}, [], 1000])}
 2638:                    || Kind <- [vote, resolve, complete]]}
 2639:                  || {Peer, Ns} <- [{Asker, ?ASKER_NS}, {Target, ?NS},
 2640:                                    {Third, ?THIRD_NS}]];
 2641:             _ ->
 2642:                 []
 2643:         end,
 2644:     BVote = phase_result(?NS, Phases, vote),
 2645:     CVote = phase_result(?THIRD_NS, Phases, vote),
 2646:     RawBVerify = raw_vote_verify(
 2647:                    Asker, ?config(target_pub, Config),
 2648:                    ?config(target_addr, Config), BVote),
 2649:     RawCVerify = raw_vote_verify(
 2650:                    Asker, ?config(third_pub, Config),
 2651:                    ?config(third_addr, Config), CVote),
 2652:     #{statuses => Statuses, phases => Phases,
 2653:       asker_internal => AskerInternal,
 2654:       raw_b_vote_verify => RawBVerify,
 2655:       raw_c_vote_verify => RawCVerify,
 2656:       foreign_log_stats =>
 2657:           [{Ns, peer:call(Peer, quod_foreign_log, stats, [])}
 2658:            || {Peer, Ns} <- [{Asker, ?ASKER_NS}, {Target, ?NS},
 2659:                              {Third, ?THIRD_NS}]],
 2660:       asker_routes =>
 2661:           [{Ns, peer:call(Asker, quod_directory, resolve, [Ns])}
 2662:            || Ns <- [?NS, ?THIRD_NS]],
 2663:       third_origin_routes =>
 2664:           peer:call(Third, quod_directory, validator_routes,
 2665:                     [?ASKER_NS,
 2666:                      peer:call(Asker, quod_simplex, genesis_hash,
 2667:                                [?ASKER_NS])])}.
 2668: 
 2669: raw_vote_verify(
 2670:   Peer, Validator, Endpoint,
 2671:   {ok, {phase, _RequestId, _Generation, {committed, Ref}}, _}) ->
 2672:     peer:call(Peer, quod_foreign_log, verify,
 2673:               [Validator, Endpoint, Ref, vote, 5000]);
 2674: raw_vote_verify(_Peer, _Validator, _Endpoint, _PhaseResult) ->
 2675:     not_committed.
 2676: 
 2677: phase_result(Ns, Phases, Kind) ->
 2678:     case lists:keyfind(Ns, 1, Phases) of
 2679:         {Ns, Results} ->
 2680:             case lists:keyfind(Kind, 1, Results) of
 2681:                 {Kind, Result} -> Result;
 2682:                 false -> not_queried
 2683:             end;
 2684:         false -> not_queried
 2685:     end.
 2686: 
 2687: dtx_internal_diagnostics(Peer, Ns) ->
 2688:     Simplex = peer:call(Peer, quod_reg, where, [{quod_simplex, Ns}]),
 2689:     case peer:call(Peer, sys, get_state, [Simplex]) of
 2690:         {running, State} ->
 2691:             Coordinator = peer:call(
 2692:                             Peer, quod_simplex,
 2693:                             test_dtx_coordinator_state, [State]),
 2694:             Counts = peer:call(Peer, quod_simplex,
 2695:                                test_dtx_endpoint_counts, [State]),
 2696:             #{coordinator => Coordinator,
 2697:               endpoint_counts => Counts};
 2698:         Other ->
 2699:             #{state => Other}
 2700:     end.
 2701: 
 2702: single_coordinator_id(Coordinators) when is_map(Coordinators) ->
 2703:     case maps:keys(Coordinators) of
 2704:         [GroupId] -> GroupId;
 2705:         _ -> undefined
 2706:     end;
 2707: single_coordinator_id(_Malformed) ->
 2708:     undefined.
 2709: 
 2710: wait_restarted(_Peer, _Ns, _OldSimplex, 0) ->
 2711:     ct:fail(origin_namespace_did_not_restart);
 2712: wait_restarted(Peer, Ns, OldSimplex, Retries) ->
 2713:     Simplex = peer:call(Peer, quod_reg, where, [{quod_simplex, Ns}]),
 2714:     Prolog = peer:call(Peer, quod_reg, where, [{quod_prolog, Ns}]),
 2715:     case is_pid(Simplex) andalso Simplex =/= OldSimplex andalso
 2716:          is_pid(Prolog) of
 2717:         true -> ok;
 2718:         false -> timer:sleep(25),
 2719:                  wait_restarted(Peer, Ns, OldSimplex, Retries - 1)
 2720:     end.
 2721: 
 2722: wait_group_outcome(_Peer, GroupRef, 0) ->
 2723:     ct:fail({group_outcome_never_became_terminal, GroupRef});
 2724: wait_group_outcome(Peer, {group, Ns, _, _, _, _} = GroupRef, Retries) ->
 2725:     case peer:call(Peer, quod_prolog, outcome, [GroupRef]) of
 2726:         {ok, #{status := Status} = Outcome}
 2727:           when Status =:= committed; Status =:= aborted -> Outcome;
 2728:         {ok, #{status := pending}} ->
 2729:             timer:sleep(50),
 2730:             wait_group_outcome(Peer, GroupRef, Retries - 1);
 2731:         {error, {outcome_unknown, GroupRef}} ->
 2732:             timer:sleep(50),
 2733:             wait_group_outcome(Peer, GroupRef, Retries - 1);
 2734:         {error, {ontology_rebuilding, Ns}} ->
 2735:             timer:sleep(50),
 2736:             wait_group_outcome(Peer, GroupRef, Retries - 1);
 2737:         Other ->
 2738:             ct:fail({unexpected_group_outcome, Other})
 2739:     end.
 2740: 
 2741: assert_fact_once(Peer, Ns, Predicate, Tag) ->
 2742:     Goal = {findall, ok, {Predicate, Tag}, {'Hits'}},
 2743:     ?assertMatch(
 2744:        {ok, [#{'Hits' := [ok]}], _},
 2745:        peer:call(Peer, quod_prolog, prove, [Ns, Goal], 10000)).
 2746: 
 2747: assert_fact_absent(Peer, Ns, Predicate, Tag) ->
 2748:     Goal = {findall, ok, {Predicate, Tag}, {'Hits'}},
 2749:     ?assertMatch(
 2750:        {ok, [#{'Hits' := []}], _},
 2751:        peer:call(Peer, quod_prolog, prove, [Ns, Goal], 10000)).
 2752: 
 2753: append_source_marker(Config, Tag) ->
 2754:     Asker = ?config(asker, Config),
 2755:     Author = ?config(asker_pub, Config),
 2756:     Anchor = ?config(asker_anchor, Config),
 2757:     {ok, Goal} = quod_durable_term:encode_goal({test_source_marker, Tag}),
 2758:     {ok, Result} = quod_durable_term:encode_result(#{}),
 2759:     PlanDigest = crypto:hash(
 2760:                    sha256,
 2761:                    term_to_binary({test_source_marker, Tag},
 2762:                                   [deterministic])),
 2763:     Change = quod_transaction:bind_id(
 2764:                {?ASKER_NS, Anchor},
 2765:                #transaction{tx_id = <<>>,
 2766:                             origin = {?ASKER_NS, Anchor},
 2767:                             proof_id = <<0:256>>, plan_digest = PlanDigest,
 2768:                             goal = Goal, result = Result,
 2769:                             diff = [{assert,
 2770:                                      {{instance_of, pet,
 2771:                                        {stale_origin_marker, Tag}}, true}}],
 2772:                             read_check = #{}, author = Author, sig = none}),
 2773:     ?assertMatch({ok, _},
 2774:                  peer:call(Asker, quod_simplex, append,
 2775:                            [?ASKER_NS, Change], 60000)).

 2778:     [{dtx_disjoint_write_chain_1, dtx_animals_mark_1,

 2780:      {dtx_disjoint_write_chain_2, dtx_animals_mark_2,
 2781:       dtx_third_write_2, dtx_third_mark_2},
 2782:      {dtx_disjoint_write_chain_3, dtx_animals_mark_3,
 2783:       dtx_third_write_3, dtx_third_mark_3},
 2784:      {dtx_disjoint_write_chain_4, dtx_animals_mark_4,
 2785:       dtx_third_write_4, dtx_third_mark_4},
 2786:      {dtx_disjoint_write_chain_5, dtx_animals_mark_5,
 2787:       dtx_third_write_5, dtx_third_mark_5},
 2788:      {dtx_disjoint_write_chain_6, dtx_animals_mark_6,
 2789:       dtx_third_write_6, dtx_third_mark_6},
 2790:      {dtx_disjoint_write_chain_7, dtx_animals_mark_7,
 2791:       dtx_third_write_7, dtx_third_mark_7},
 2792:      {dtx_disjoint_write_chain_8, dtx_animals_mark_8,
 2793:       dtx_third_write_8, dtx_third_mark_8}].

 2795: dtx_disjoint_target_rules() ->
 2796:     [io_lib:format(
 2797:        "~s(X) :- assertz(~s(X)), third::~s(X).~n",
 2798:        [atom_to_list(Chain), atom_to_list(Local),
 2799:         atom_to_list(RemoteWriter)])
 2800:      || {Chain, Local, RemoteWriter, _RemoteFact} <-
 2801:             dtx_disjoint_predicates()].
 2802: 
 2803: dtx_disjoint_third_rules() ->
 2804:     [io_lib:format(
 2805:        "~s(X) :- assertz(~s(X)).~n",
 2806:        [atom_to_list(RemoteWriter), atom_to_list(RemoteFact)])
 2807:      || {_Chain, _Local, RemoteWriter, RemoteFact} <-
 2808:             dtx_disjoint_predicates()].

 2810: collect_gateway_race(_Ref, 0, Results) -> lists:reverse(Results);
 2811: collect_gateway_race(Ref, Remaining, Results) ->
 2812:     receive
 2813:         {Ref, Gateway, Result} ->
 2814:             collect_gateway_race(
 2815:               Ref, Remaining - 1, [{Gateway, Result} | Results])
 2816:     after 65000 ->
 2817:         ct:fail({gateway_race_timeout, Remaining})
 2818:     end.
 2819: 
 2820: classify_race_submit(
 2821:   {ok, Evidence, {normalized, {committed, _Bindings, _Outcome}}}) ->
 2822:     {accepted, Evidence};
 2823: classify_race_submit(
 2824:   {ok, Evidence, {normalized, {pending, _PendingRef}}}) ->
 2825:     %% A multi-ontology proof may already be durably represented by its group
 2826:     %% reference.  The signed operation remains the stable public lookup key
 2827:     %% in either case, and is resolved below without resubmitting.
 2828:     {accepted, Evidence};
 2829: classify_race_submit({error, signed_target_unavailable}) ->
 2830:     pre_custody_unavailable;
 2831: classify_race_submit({error, busy}) ->
 2832:     pre_custody_unavailable;
 2833: classify_race_submit(Other) ->
 2834:     ct:fail({gateway_race_submit_failed, Other}).

 2836: concurrent_submit_evidence(
 2837:   _Index,

 2847: %% The losing group can be reported either while still pending or directly as
 2848: %% its certified abort. In both cases the signed evidence carries
 2849: %% the same operation reference whose final durable outcome is asserted below.
 2850: concurrent_conflict_evidence(
 2851:   _Index,
 2852:   {ok, Evidence, {normalized, {committed, _Bindings, _Outcome}}}) ->
 2853:     Evidence;

 2855:   _Index,

 2857:     Evidence;

 2859:   _Index,
 2860:   {ok, Evidence, {normalized, {failed, _Reasons}}}) ->
 2861:     Evidence;
 2862: concurrent_conflict_evidence(Index, Other) ->
 2863:     ct:fail({concurrent_signed_conflict_submit_failed, Index, Other}).

 2865: wait_operation_claim(_Target, OperationRef, 0) ->
 2866:     ct:fail({operation_outcome_timeout, OperationRef});
 2867: wait_operation_claim(Target, OperationRef, Remaining) ->
 2868:     case peer:call(Target, quod_prolog, outcome, [OperationRef]) of
 2869:         {ok, #{status := claimed, outcome_ref := OutcomeRef} = Claim} ->
 2870:             case peer:call(Target, quod_prolog, outcome, [OutcomeRef]) of
 2871:                 {ok, #{status := committed} = Outcome} -> {Claim, Outcome};
 2872:                 {ok, #{status := pending}} ->
 2873:                     timer:sleep(50),
 2874:                     wait_operation_claim(Target, OperationRef, Remaining - 1);
 2875:                 {error, _} ->
 2876:                     timer:sleep(50),
 2877:                     wait_operation_claim(Target, OperationRef, Remaining - 1);
 2878:                 Other ->
 2879:                     ct:fail({unexpected_operation_outcome, Other})
 2880:             end;
 2881:         {error, _} ->
 2882:             timer:sleep(50),
 2883:             wait_operation_claim(Target, OperationRef, Remaining - 1);
 2884:         Other ->
 2885:             ct:fail({unexpected_operation_claim, Other})
 2886:     end.
 2887: 
 2888: completed_remote_operation(Target, OperationRef, 0) ->
 2889:     ct:fail(
 2890:       {operation_completion_timeout, OperationRef,
 2891:        peer:call(Target, quod_simplex, stats, [?ASKER_NS])});
 2892: completed_remote_operation(Target, OperationRef, Remaining) ->
 2893:     case peer:call(Target, quod_prolog, outcome, [OperationRef]) of
 2894:         {ok, #{status := claimed, operation_state := terminal,
 2895:                outcome_ref := {applications, [OutcomeRef]}, included := Included}} ->
 2896:             ?assertMatch([{_, {certified, OutcomeRef, _}}], Included),
 2897:             ?assertEqual({ok, [OutcomeRef]}, quod_operation_vector:receipt_references(Included)),
 2898:             case peer:call(Target, quod_prolog, outcome, [OutcomeRef]) of
 2899:                 {ok, #{status := committed, ref := OutcomeRef}} -> OutcomeRef;
 2900:                 _ ->
 2901:                     timer:sleep(50),
 2902:                     completed_remote_operation(
 2903:                       Target, OperationRef, Remaining - 1)
 2904:             end;
 2905:         _ ->
 2906:             timer:sleep(50),
 2907:             completed_remote_operation(Target, OperationRef, Remaining - 1)
 2908:     end.
 2909: 
 2910: wait_operation_terminal(_Target, OperationRef, 0) ->
 2911:     ct:fail({operation_outcome_timeout, OperationRef});
 2912: wait_operation_terminal(Target, OperationRef, Remaining) ->
 2913:     case peer:call(Target, quod_prolog, outcome, [OperationRef]) of
 2914:         {ok, #{status := claimed, outcome_ref := OutcomeRef} = Claim} ->
 2915:             case peer:call(Target, quod_prolog, outcome, [OutcomeRef]) of
 2916:                 {ok, #{status := Status} = Outcome}
 2917:                   when Status =:= committed; Status =:= aborted ->
 2918:                     {Claim, Outcome};
 2919:                 _ ->
 2920:                     timer:sleep(50),
 2921:                     wait_operation_terminal(Target, OperationRef, Remaining - 1)
 2922:             end;
 2923:         _ ->
 2924:             timer:sleep(50),
 2925:             wait_operation_terminal(Target, OperationRef, Remaining - 1)
 2926:     end.
 2927: 
 2928: wait_remote_operation(_Gateway, _SessionId, _RequestBytes, _Signature,
 2929:                       _ClientPeer, 0) ->
 2930:     ct:fail(remote_operation_outcome_timeout);
 2931: wait_remote_operation(Gateway, SessionId, RequestBytes, Signature,
 2932:                       ClientPeer, Remaining) ->
 2933:     Result = peer:call(
 2934:                Gateway, quod_client_goal_ingress, resolve_operation,
 2935:                [SessionId, RequestBytes, Signature, ClientPeer], 10000),
 2936:     case Result of
 2937:         {ok, _, {operation_outcome, _, _}} -> Result;
 2938:         {ok, _, {operation_pending, _}} when Remaining =:= 1 ->
 2939:             ct:fail({remote_operation_outcome_timeout, Result});
 2940:         {ok, _, {operation_pending, _}} ->
 2941:             timer:sleep(250),
 2942:             wait_remote_operation(
 2943:               Gateway, SessionId, RequestBytes, Signature,
 2944:               ClientPeer, Remaining - 1);
 2945:         {error, client_goal_rate_limited} when Remaining =:= 1 ->
 2946:             ct:fail({remote_operation_outcome_timeout, Result});
 2947:         {error, client_goal_rate_limited} ->
 2948:             timer:sleep(250),
 2949:             wait_remote_operation(
 2950:               Gateway, SessionId, RequestBytes, Signature,
 2951:               ClientPeer, Remaining - 1);
 2952:         Other ->
 2953:             ct:fail({remote_operation_outcome_invalid, Other})
 2954:     end.

 2956: assert_dtx_released(Peer, Ns) ->
 2957:     Status = peer:call(Peer, quod_simplex, status, [Ns]),
 2958:     Projection = maps:get(history_projection, Status),
 2959:     Dtx = maps:get(dtx, Projection),
 2960:     ?assertEqual(#{}, maps:get(groups, Dtx)),
 2961:     ?assertEqual(#{}, maps:get(apply_fences, Dtx)).

 2963: run_scope_wave(Asker, Goal, Wave) ->
 2964:     %% `run_scope_proofs/3` owns a 10-second completion window. The peer call
 2965:     %% must outlive it; its default five seconds can otherwise time out before
 2966:     %% the helper can report the actual wave result.
 2967:     Results = peer:call(
 2968:                 Asker, ?MODULE, run_scope_proofs,
 2969:                 [?ASKER_NS, Goal, ?SCOPE_WAVE_SIZE], 15000),
 2970:     case Results of
 2971:         List when is_list(List), length(List) =:= ?SCOPE_WAVE_SIZE ->
 2972:             lists:foreach(
 2973:               fun({ok, [_], _}) -> ok;
 2974:                  (Result) -> ct:fail({scope_proof_failed, Wave, Result})
 2975:               end, List);
 2976:         timeout -> ct:fail({scope_proof_timeout, Wave});
 2977:         Other -> ct:fail({scope_proof_wave_failed, Wave, Other})
 2978:     end.
 2979: 
 2980: run_scope_proofs(Ns, Goal, Count) ->
 2981:     Parent = self(),
 2982:     _ = [spawn(fun() -> Parent ! {proof_done, quod_prolog:prove(Ns, Goal)} end)
 2983:          || _ <- lists:seq(1, Count)],
 2984:     collect_scope_proofs(Count, []).
 2985: 
 2986: collect_scope_proofs(0, Results) -> lists:reverse(Results);
 2987: collect_scope_proofs(Count, Results) ->
 2988:     receive
 2989:         {proof_done, Result} -> collect_scope_proofs(Count - 1, [Result | Results])
 2990:     after 10000 ->
 2991:         timeout
 2992:     end.

 2994: set_network_identity(Peer, NetworkId) ->
 2995:     Desired = peer:call(
 2996:                 Peer, application, get_env,
 2997:                 [quod, namespace_desired, #{}]),
 2998:     Content = maps:get(content, Desired, #{}),
 2999:     ok = peer:call(
 3000:            Peer, application, set_env,
 3001:            [quod, namespace_desired,
 3002:             Desired#{content => Content#{
 3003:               quod_ontology:root_ns() => #{genesis_hash => NetworkId}}}]).

 3005: open_client_session(Peer, NetworkId, NodeKey,
 3006:                     KeyPair = {PublicKey, _Seed}, ClientPeer) ->
 3007:     ClientNonce = crypto:strong_rand_bytes(32),
 3008:     {ok, Challenge} = peer:call(
 3009:                         Peer, quod_client_auth, issue_challenge,
 3010:                         [PublicKey, ClientNonce, ClientPeer]),
 3011:     ChallengeId = maps:get(challenge_id, Challenge),
 3012:     {ok, ChallengeBytes} = quod_client_auth:challenge_bytes(
 3013:                              NetworkId, NodeKey, ChallengeId, PublicKey,
 3014:                              ClientNonce, maps:get(server_nonce, Challenge),
 3015:                              maps:get(expires_ms, Challenge)),
 3016:     Signature = quod_identity:sign(
 3017:                   ChallengeBytes, quod_identity:key_term(KeyPair)),
 3018:     {ok, Session} = peer:call(
 3019:                       Peer, quod_client_auth, complete_challenge,
 3020:                       [ChallengeId, Signature]),
 3021:     Session.

 3023: signed_goal_request(NetworkId, PublicKey, KeyPair, AgentNamespace, AgentAnchor,
 3024:                     SessionExpires, GoalText) ->
 3025:     signed_goal_request(NetworkId, PublicKey, KeyPair,
 3026:                         AgentNamespace, AgentAnchor,

 3029: signed_goal_request(NetworkId, PublicKey, KeyPair,
 3030:                     AgentNamespace, AgentAnchor,
 3031:                     SessionExpires, Mode, GoalText) ->
 3032:     Request = #{network_identity => NetworkId,
 3033:                 signing_public_key => PublicKey,
 3034:                 operation_id => crypto:strong_rand_bytes(32),
 3035:                 agent_namespace => AgentNamespace,
 3036:                 agent_genesis_anchor => AgentAnchor,
 3037:                 agent_instance_text => <<"human_user(test_agent).">>,
 3038:                 mode => Mode, parser_version => 1,
 3039:                 not_after_ms => min(
 3040:                                   SessionExpires,
 3041:                                   quod_time:now_ms() + 30000),
 3042:                 goal_text => GoalText},
 3043:     {ok, Bytes} = quod_client_goal:encode(Request),
 3044:     {Bytes,
 3045:      quod_identity:sign(Bytes, quod_identity:key_term(KeyPair))}.

 3047: submit_signed_execute(Config, GoalText) ->
 3048:     NetworkId = ?config(network_id, Config),
 3049:     AgentPub = ?config(agent_pub, Config),
 3050:     AgentKey = ?config(agent_key, Config),
 3051:     AgentAnchor = ?config(asker_anchor, Config),
 3052:     Session = ?config(client_session, Config),
 3053:     {RequestBytes, Signature} = signed_goal_request(
 3054:                                   NetworkId, AgentPub, AgentKey,
 3055:                                   ?ASKER_NS, AgentAnchor,
 3056:                                   maps:get(expires_ms, Session), execute,
 3057:                                   GoalText),
 3058:     peer:call(
 3059:       ?config(asker, Config), quod_client_goal_ingress, submit,
 3060:       [execute, maps:get(session_id, Session), RequestBytes, Signature,
 3061:        ?config(client_peer, Config)], 60000).

 3063: prolog_binary_literal(Bytes) ->
 3064:     iolist_to_binary(
 3065:       ["<<\"",
 3066:        [["\\x", io_lib:format("~2.16.0B", [Byte]), "\\"]
 3067:         || <<Byte>> <= Bytes],
 3068:        "\">>"]).

 3070: start_node(Name, Port, {Pub, Seed}, Ns, Genesis, Seeds,
 3071:            DirectoryAllowlist, Config) ->
 3072:     %% Peer nodes must load the beam being tested.  `code:get_path/0` also
 3073:     %% contains dependency and older build paths, so put this suite's exact
 3074:     %% Quod ebin first instead of relying on their incidental ordering.
 3075:     QuodEbin = filename:dirname(code:which(quod_simplex)),
 3076:     PeerPaths = [QuodEbin | lists:delete(QuodEbin, code:get_path())],
 3077:     {ok, Peer, _Node} = peer:start(
 3078:                           #{name => Name, connection => standard_io,
 3079:                             args => ["-pa" | PeerPaths]}),
 3080:     lists:foreach(
 3081:       fun(Module) ->
 3082:           {module, Module} = peer:call(
 3083:                                Peer, code, ensure_loaded, [Module]),
 3084:           QuodEbin = filename:dirname(
 3085:                        peer:call(Peer, code, which, [Module]))
 3086:       end, [quod_simplex, quod_scope_session, quod_ask]),
 3087:     true = peer:call(
 3088:              Peer, erlang, function_exported,
 3089:              [quod_simplex, start_link, 2]),
 3090:     %% Runtime lifecycle preparation may legitimately use the application's
 3091:     %% default data root. Keep that root private to this peer and CT run: the
 3092:     %% VM-local unique_integer/1 sequence restarts in later runs, so sharing
 3093:     %% the developer cache could reopen an old genesis under a dead test key.
 3094:     CacheDir = filename:join(
 3095:                  ?config(priv_dir, Config),
 3096:                  atom_to_list(Name) ++ "_cache"),
 3097:     true = peer:call(
 3098:              Peer, os, putenv, ["XDG_CACHE_HOME", CacheDir]),
 3099:     _ = peer:call(Peer, logger, set_primary_config, [level, warning]),
 3100:     _ = peer:call(Peer, application, load, [quod]),
 3101:     Key = quod_identity:key_term({Pub, Seed}),
 3102:     Set = fun(K, V) -> ok = peer:call(Peer, application, set_env, [quod, K, V]) end,
 3103:     Set(listen_port, Port),
 3104:     Set(node_addr, {"127.0.0.1", Port}),
 3105:     Set(node_pubkey, Pub),
 3106:     Set(identity_key, Key),
 3107:     Set(identity_cert, quod_identity:mint_cert({Pub, Seed})),
 3108:     Set(effect_journal_data_dir,
 3109:         filename:join(
 3110:           ?config(priv_dir, Config),
 3111:           atom_to_list(Name) ++ "_effect_journal")),
 3112:     Set(foreign_log,
 3113:         #{cache_dir => filename:join(
 3114:                          ?config(priv_dir, Config),
 3115:                          atom_to_list(Name) ++ "_foreign_log")}),
 3116:     %% These peers do not run the production directory-advertisement loop for
 3117:     %% every synthetic namespace. Keep their explicit certified route fixtures
 3118:     %% alive for the whole suite so long-running protocol cases test the route,
 3119:     %% not fixture expiry.
 3120:     _ = DirectoryAllowlist,
 3121:     Set(directory, #{ttl_ms => 600000, expire_tick_ms => 60000}),
 3122:     {ok, _} = peer:call(Peer, application, ensure_all_started, [quod]),
 3123:     start_namespace(Peer, Pub, Ns, Genesis, Seeds, Config),
 3124:     Peer.
 3125: 
 3126: start_namespace(Peer, Pub, Ns, Genesis, Seeds, Config) ->
 3127:     DataDir = filename:join(
 3128:                 ?config(priv_dir, Config),
 3129:                 unicode:characters_to_list(
 3130:                   [atom_to_list(peer:call(Peer, erlang, node, [])),
 3131:                    "_", Ns])),
 3132:     Cfg = #{node_id => Pub, mode => create, role => member,
 3133:             data_dir => DataDir, seed_peers => Seeds,
 3134:             genesis_file => Genesis},
 3135:     {ok, _} = peer:call(Peer, quod_ns_sup, start_namespace, [Ns, Cfg]),
 3136:     ok.

 3173: wait_ready(Peer, Ns, _Goal, 0) ->
 3174:     ct:fail(

 3183: wait_ready(Peer, Ns, Goal, Retries) ->
 3184:     case peer:call(Peer, quod_prolog, prove, [Ns, Goal], 5000) of
 3185:         {error, rebuilding} ->

 3187:             wait_ready(Peer, Ns, Goal, Retries - 1);
 3188:         {ok, _, _} -> ok;
 3189:         Other -> ct:fail({not_ready, Ns, Other})
 3190:     end.

 3196: wait_engine_stat(_Peer, _Ns, _Key, _Expected, 0) ->

 3198: wait_engine_stat(Peer, Ns, Key, Expected, Retries) ->

 3207: key_before(TargetPub) ->
 3208:     {Pub, _} = Key = quod_identity:generate(),
 3209:     case Pub < TargetPub of
 3210:         true -> Key;
 3211:         false -> key_before(TargetPub)
 3212:     end.

 3214: deep_failure_rules() ->
 3215:     [[io_lib:format("deep_failure(~B) :- deep_failure(~B).~n", [N, N - 1])
 3216:       || N <- lists:seq(70, 1, -1)],
 3217:      "deep_failure(0) :- fail_with_reason(deep_bottom).\n",
 3218:      %% Build the deliberately over-depth reason at proof time.  Canonical
 3219:      %% ledger material is depth-bounded, so embedding that value as a genesis
 3220:      %% literal would test genesis rejection instead of reply truncation.
 3221:      "bounded_reason :- deep_reason_value(63, deep_bottom, Reason), !, "
 3222:      "fail_with_reason(Reason).\n"
 3223:      "deep_reason :- deep_reason_value(70, deep_bottom, Reason), !, "
 3224:      "fail_with_reason(Reason).\n"
 3225:      "deep_reason_value(0, Acc, Acc).\n"
 3226:      "deep_reason_value(N, Acc, Out) :- N > 0, Next is N - 1, "
 3227:      "deep_reason_value(Next, [Acc], Out).\n"].
